# Bitshifter domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-88f758ea7235

Bitshifter lets the Automation Ribbon Reader and Ribbon Writer select any of bits 1 to 31 instead of 1 to 4, and draws the selected bit on the buildings. It adds no buildings of its own: every entity below is a vanilla game class the mod patches, or a mod class that does the patching. Source is in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-0fc6620ccba9

### BitshifterMod
**Id:** blk-976bcafad5d2  
**Description**: The `UserMod2` entry point. Applies the patches in `OnAllModsLoaded` (not `OnLoad`) so the compatibility check sees every other mod's patches, and stands down when another mod already widens the reader or writer.  
**Location**: `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| Bits | const int (31) | Highest selectable bit. Bit 32 is the int's sign bit and the game tests bits with `> 0`, so it never reads as on |
| YieldToWorkshopIds / YieldToStaticIds | string[] | Digital CPU: Workshop 3244925649, staticID `OniSmallCpu` |
| Contested | MethodBase[] | `GetBitDepth` and `OnSpawn` on `LogicRibbonReader` and `LogicRibbonWriter`; an existing Harmony owner on any of them makes the mod stand down |

**Relationships**: calls `OverlayLabelGuard.Apply` first (always), then `WhyYield`; if that returns a reason it logs "Disabled: ..." and returns, otherwise `harmony.PatchAll` over the mod assembly.

### Reader and Writer bit depth
**Id:** blk-d5c2d70c3f11  
**Description**: `LogicRibbonReader.GetBitDepth` and `LogicRibbonWriter.GetBitDepth` are postfixed to return `Bits`. The bit selector side screen builds one row per `GetBitDepth()`, and both buildings already shift by the selected bit with no upper bound, so this is the whole functional change.  
**Location**: `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` (`LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `LogicRibbonWriter_GetBitDepth_Patch`)

**Relationships**: the selected bit is the game's own saved `selectedBit` field, so it is saved with the building and copied by copy-settings with no mod code.

### Display
**Id:** blk-cd081718a091  
**Description**: Shared draw code for both buildings. Replaces the vanilla four bit lights with a two-digit seven-segment display of the selected bit (1-based) and one light for that bit's state.  
**Location**: `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` (`Display`)

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| ReaderAnim / WriterAnim | string | `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim`, `bitshifter_ribbon_writer_kanim`, built by `tools/make_art.py` into `src/Bitshifter/anim/assets` |
| Signal, OutputLight, InputLight | KAnimHashedString | Symbols `signal_bloom`, `output_light_bloom`, `input_light_bloom` tinted with the building's on and off colours |
| Segments | KAnimHashedString[2,7] | Symbols `seg_a_1` to `seg_g_2`, shown or hidden per digit |
| WriterUpsideDown / ReaderUpsideDown | Orientation | R270 for the writer, R90 for the reader; at those orientations the digits trade places and each segment trades with its opposite |

**Relationships**: `LogicRibbonReaderConfig` and `LogicRibbonWriterConfig` `CreateBuildingDef` postfixes swap in the mod's kanims through `Display.UseAnim` (the vanilla art is kept with a warning if the kanim is missing). `LogicRibbonReader.UpdateVisuals` and `LogicRibbonWriter.UpdateVisuals` are replaced by prefixes that return false and call `Display.Update`.

### LogicBitSelectorSideScreen scroll view
**Id:** blk-3546b9b4bcd4  
**Description**: A postfix on `LogicBitSelectorSideScreen.SetTarget` wraps the rows' container in a `KScrollRect` (with `RectMask2D`, `LayoutElement` and `ContentSizeFitter`) the first time the screen is shown. The viewport is 1.5 times the height of the vanilla four rows, with a permanent scrollbar cloned from a vanilla side screen (a flat-colour bar is the fallback). The same postfix clamps layout widths to the details panel header (280 px against the vanilla 316 px ask).  
**Location**: `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/SideScreen.cs`

**Relationships**: `IsWrapped` checks the row list's direct parent so reopening the screen does not nest a second scroll view.

### NOT gate mask
**Id:** blk-5f2b3567543d  
**Description**: A transpiler on `LogicGate.UpdateState` replaces the single `& 15` (four-bit mask) with `Mask` = `(1 << 31) - 1`, so a NOT gate with a ribbon input inverts all 31 bits. If the method has no such mask or more than one, it is left alone and a warning is logged.  
**Location**: `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` (`LogicGate_UpdateState_Patch`)

### OverlayLabelGuard
**Id:** blk-4919a4967bb1  
**Description**: When Better Automation Overlay (Workshop 1878896484) is enabled, prefixes every `GetSetting` on its `LogicLabelSetting` labels so a label that has not spawned yet returns blank text instead of throwing a NullReferenceException every frame. Applies even when the rest of the mod stands down.  
**Location**: `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/OverlayLabelGuard.cs`

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-de8c66751b82

- The reader and writer offer bits 1 to 31 and no more.
- A reader set to a high bit outputs that bit on a 1-bit wire, or the value shifted down by that many bits on a ribbon; a writer shifts its input up by the selected bit. This is the game's own shifting; the mod changes no arithmetic.
- The NOT gate inverts 31 bits. Other gates already work on every bit; Buffer and Filter output a single bit, as in the base game.
- The mod stands down and logs the reason when Digital CPU is enabled, or when any other mod has Harmony-patched `GetBitDepth` or `OnSpawn` on the reader or writer by the time all mods have loaded.
- Removing the mod leaves a building set above bit 4 working; the vanilla side screen shows no selection for it until a bit is picked again.
- No PLib, no options, no strings.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-2fe104dbf053

- **Startup and yield check**: `OnAllModsLoaded` runs the guard, `WhyYield`, then `PatchAll` — see `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`
- **Drawing the selected bit**: `UpdateVisuals` prefix, `Display.Update`, `SetDigit` — see `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`
- **Scrolling bit list**: `SetTarget` postfix, `Wrap`, `FitUnderHeader` — see `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/SideScreen.cs`
- **Overlay crash guard**: `OverlayLabelGuard.Apply` — see `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/OverlayLabelGuard.cs`
- **Art build**: `tools/make_art.py` writes the two kanims from the game's own reader and writer kanims; `--check` fails when committed kanims differ from a fresh build
- **Tests**: in-game tests in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter.Tests/` (`Compatibility.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `Readout.cs`, `Settings.cs`, `SideScreen.cs`, `Signals.cs`)

## Related
**Id:** blk-d6aecc1ac010

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Domain Glossary

Terms used in the Bitshifter mod (`mods/bitshifter`). For the classes and patches behind them, see the entities document.

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-c32654e0f564

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod is for |
| kanim | Klei animation | The game's sprite-animation asset (`*_kanim`); the mod ships its own for the reader and writer |
| ONICPU | Digital CPU (staticID `OniSmallCpu`, Workshop 3244925649) | A mod that already widens ribbons to 32 bits; Bitshifter yields to it |
| BAO | Better Automation Overlay (Workshop 1878896484) | Mod whose overlay labels `OverlayLabelGuard` protects |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-cf5e7783d48c

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Bit 32 | Bits 1-31 | Bit 32 is the int's sign bit; the game tests bits with `> 0`, so it never reads as on and the mod leaves it out |
| Bit 0 | Bit 1 | The side screen and the display number bits from 1; the stored `selectedBit` is 0-based, so the display shows `selectedBit + 1` |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-e56acb84a125

### Ribbon
**Id:** blk-21a5cd486094  
**Definition**: An automation wire that carries a 32-bit integer signal; the game exposes the low four bits. A ribbon carries up to 31 independent signals with this mod.  
**Used in**: Reader, Writer, NOT gate mask

### Automation Ribbon Reader
**Id:** blk-e56d7b368a41  
**Definition**: Building (`LogicRibbonReader`) that picks one bit from a ribbon, or shifts the value down by that many bits onto a ribbon output.  
**Used in**: bit depth patch, `UpdateVisuals` patch, side screen

### Ribbon Writer
**Id:** blk-0353e0e524cb  
**Definition**: Building (`LogicRibbonWriter`) that shifts a 1-bit or ribbon input up by the selected bit onto a ribbon.  
**Used in**: bit depth patch, `UpdateVisuals` patch, side screen

### Bit depth
**Id:** blk-317285d31e79  
**Definition**: What `GetBitDepth()` returns: how many bits the selector side screen lists. Vanilla returns 4; the mod returns 31.  
**Used in**: `Patches.cs`, `Mod.cs` (`Bits`)

### Bit selector side screen
**Id:** blk-64dad4f78a5e  
**Definition**: The details-panel screen (`LogicBitSelectorSideScreen`) with one row per bit. The mod puts its rows in a scroll view.  
**Used in**: `SideScreen.cs`

### Selected bit
**Id:** blk-a6c85b35c760  
**Definition**: The building's saved bit choice (`selectedBit`, 0-based internally, shown 1-based). Saved with the building and copied by copy-settings.  
**Used in**: `Display.Update`, tests in `Settings.cs`

### Port lights
**Id:** blk-b5a06fba0850  
**Definition**: The input and output lights on a logic building that show whether a wire is connected and its state; the mod keeps them and tints them with the building's on and off colours.  
**Used in**: `Display`

### Stand down
**Id:** blk-ce9d17157555  
**Definition**: The mod applies no patches (apart from the overlay guard) and logs why, because another mod already handles the widening.  
**Used in**: `Mod.cs` (`WhyYield`)

## Related
**Id:** blk-e9bc1a155ba9

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# bitshifter

## What this is
**Id:** blk-037b09df0318

Bitshifter is an Oxygen Not Included mod that lets the Automation Ribbon Reader and Ribbon Writer select any of bits 1 to 31 instead of 1 to 4, so one ribbon can carry up to 31 independent signals. The bit selector side screen lists Bit 1 to Bit 31 in a scroll view, both buildings show the selected bit on an amber two-digit display with a light for that bit's state, and a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts all 31 bits. The mod steps aside and logs it when Digital CPU is enabled or another mod already patches the reader's or writer's bit depth. Version 1.2.0 in `mod_info.yaml`, minimum supported build 744825, published on the Steam Workshop. Players of ribbon-based automation builds use it.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-977e72b83a82

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/Bitshifter/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point and compatibility checks), `Patches.cs` (bit depth, building defs, visuals, display and NOT gate patches), `SideScreen.cs` (the 31-bit selector), `OverlayLabelGuard.cs` (keeps Better Automation Overlay labels working), `anim/` (reader and writer art), `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/Bitshifter.Tests/`: in-game tests for compatibility, gates, readout, settings, side screen and signals.
- `tools/make_art.py`: generates the building art.
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and the packaged mod.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-c9711fdcdf52
description: "C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions for Bitshifter (widens the Ribbon Reader and Writer to 31 bits), with this mod's own layout."
applies_to:

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-560325a10a42

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-4fdb0f5fa329

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-f9bb4b2c4543

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-eae90ee208f9

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-cf9a03ea8a94

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-a655f79fe2d4

### Organization
**Id:** blk-fc2efcca0eed

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-32ae0ce82848

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-aa5709424e26

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-764a3de83887

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-783d01891abf

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-da6960b7a77e

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-492ab9ff4ab1

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-24f0ce307136

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-eb6b4b01a219

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-7777e7f3c39a

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-c3e49ad21d32

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-9703c0ddcb30

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-e8781e877267

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Bitshifter specifics
**Id:** blk-7a89bf1fb99c

- Patches are applied from `OnAllModsLoaded` with `harmony.PatchAll(typeof(BitshifterMod).Assembly)`, not from `base.OnLoad`, so every other mod patches first. `OnLoad` only logs (`src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Patch classes are `internal static` and live in `src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`; the drawing code they share is the internal static class `Display` in the same file.
- Uses `ReferenceUnityUI` only: no PLib, no translations. The side screen is built by hand (`src/Bitshifter/SideScreen.cs`).
- Art is in `src/Bitshifter/anim`; `tools/make_art.py` generates it.

## Related
**Id:** blk-9864e2e99ea5

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-072f1d1bd309
description: "How Bitshifter guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Error Handling Conventions

## Principles
**Id:** blk-0bb5eb7f778f

1. **Never break the game for a mod's sake.** A patch that cannot do its job leaves the vanilla behaviour in place and says so in the log. It does not throw into the game's update loop.
2. **Check what you patch.** Game updates rename fields and move code. Every reflection lookup, transpiler match and prefab or tech lookup is checked for a miss.
3. **Say what degraded.** A warning names the thing that was not found and the consequence, so a bug report with `Player.log` is enough to diagnose.
4. **Don't swallow.** A `catch` logs and either returns a safe default or continues; it is never empty.
5. **Log at the right level.** `Debug.Log` for start-up and summaries, `Debug.LogWarning` for degraded behaviour, `Debug.LogError` for a failed player action.

There is no custom exception hierarchy. Mods are small patches over game code, so errors are handled where they occur.

## Guarding Patches
**Id:** blk-f58ec17fc16f

### Missing member: warn, leave vanilla
**Id:** blk-f6d1dcb29771

A reflection lookup that returns null is checked before use. The patch then does nothing, or returns `true` from a prefix so the game's method runs.

```csharp
if (ActiveField == null || StorageField == null)
	return true; // the game renamed its fields: leave vanilla alone rather than throw
```
(`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/Patches.cs`; the warning is logged once at load by `SimTransferMethod` in `FridgeThermostat.cs`.)

### Transpiler: count the match
**Id:** blk-4c8d79f7826c

A transpiler counts the instructions it replaced. Zero (or more than expected) logs a warning and returns the original code, so a game update disables the change instead of breaking the method.

```csharp
if (swapped == 0)
	Debug.LogWarning("[CornerBuildAnything] " + where + " does not load OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable; corner reach not applied there");
```
(`mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`; same pattern in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` and `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`.)

### Missing data: warn, continue
**Id:** blk-101c18a7fdbd

A build-menu, tech or asset lookup that finds nothing warns and keeps the mod working:

```csharp
Tech tech = Db.Get().Techs.TryGet(TechId);
if (tech == null)
{
	Debug.LogWarning("[SmartWeightPlate] Tech '" + TechId + "' not found; building will be unlocked from the start");
	return;
}
```
(`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Patches.cs`; also `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor`, `mods/storage-pod-redux`.) Missing art or a missing vanilla prefab degrades the same way (`Display.UseAnim` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`, `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor/src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`).

### Null checks on game objects
**Id:** blk-414d69d4cbc7

Components and arguments that can be absent are tested before use: `if (stt == null || !Sim.IsValidHandle(stt.SimHandle)) return true;`, `if (sensor == null || GameScenePartitioner.Instance == null) return;` (`mods/motion-sensor-range/src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`).

### Warn once
**Id:** blk-c82c23f2d522

Work that repeats every frame or tick warns once behind a flag (`warnedMissingInternals` in `RangeSlider.cs`).

## try/catch
**Id:** blk-6a2fff2949c6

`try`/`catch (Exception e)` is used in four situations and nowhere else:

1. **Optional integration with another mod.** Patching or reading another mod's types may fail for any reason. Log the message and skip the integration (`BetterAutomationOverlayCompat.Apply` in `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`; `mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Compat/BlueprintsCompat.cs`).
2. **File and JSON reads and writes.** Return an empty or null result (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan/Presets.cs`, `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/ModDetection.cs`, `mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ToolIcon.cs`).
3. **Patches that run inside worldgen or per-cell work**, where an escaping exception kills a thread or a whole pass (`mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/FeaturePatch.cs`, `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `Census.cs`).
4. **Per-job work in a queue**, so one failure does not stop the rest (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Tool/PlacementQueue.cs`, logged with `Debug.LogError`).

The message form is `"[<Name>] <what was skipped>: " + e.Message`. Use `e.GetBaseException().Message` when the exception may be a reflection wrapper, and the full `e` when the stack trace is needed.

### Finalizer for a thread with no handler
**Id:** blk-5ee735ed820d

`Cluster.BeginGeneration` is the worldgen thread body and has none; an exception ends the thread and the loading screen waits forever. A finalizer reports the failure through the game's own error path and logs the exception (`Cluster_BeginGeneration_Patch` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/WorldgenThreadPatch.cs`).

## Yielding to Other Mods
**Id:** blk-a00c59375f90

When another mod already does the job or shares an id, the mod steps aside and logs why:
- Bitshifter disables itself when Digital CPU is enabled or the contested methods already have Harmony owners (`WhyYield` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Storage Pod Redux does not register its buildings while the original Storage Pod is enabled, and logs a warning telling the player to disable one (`mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Mod.cs`).

## Logging
**Id:** blk-4d5a8b5ca2d3

### Log Levels
**Id:** blk-ac719050ae36

| Level | Use For | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `Debug.LogError` | A player action failed and was abandoned | `PlacementQueue` in `mods/upgrade-planner` |
| `Debug.LogWarning` | Degraded or skipped behaviour | the examples above |
| `Debug.Log` | Load line, a one-line summary of what a pass changed | `Tagged N refined metal(s)` in `mods/refined-building` |

### What to Include
**Id:** blk-b9db9eb013ce

- The `[<ModName>] ` prefix on every line; `JumperBridgesMod.LogPrefix` holds it for that mod.
- What was expected, what was found, and what the mod does instead.
- Cell numbers, building names and element ids when they identify the case (`mods/vent-freeze-fix`).
- Per-tick or per-frame telemetry only behind a debug option (`VentFreezeWatcher.Verbose`, `DebugSave.Enabled`) or capped (`DetailLines` in `SettleSimPatch.cs`).

PLib's `PUtil.Log*` helpers are not used; all mods log through `Debug`.

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
**Id:** blk-6b6c2c499c77

### Swallowing exceptions
**Id:** blk-a47a6871cf99

An empty `catch` hides a broken patch. The one `catch` that returns a fallback without a log is `GuessLanguageCode` in `common/src/Translations.cs`, because a missing language preference is the normal case before the game has started.

### Throwing from a patch
**Id:** blk-8e4df099120b

An exception in a prefix or postfix on a per-frame or sim method repeats every frame. Guard, log once, return.

### Assuming the game's internals
**Id:** blk-eeb5a4c82b08

Reading a private field by name without a null check on the `FieldInfo`, or replacing an instruction without confirming it was found, breaks on the next game update.

### Silent degradation
**Id:** blk-808efb5834b2

Doing nothing without a log line leaves a player and the author guessing. Every skipped path logs.

### Spamming the log
**Id:** blk-ce98740db45a

A warning inside an update method fires thousands of times. Use a once-flag.

## Project-Specific Patterns
**Id:** blk-8eee65100c09

### Bitshifter specifics
**Id:** blk-61aafbf82371

- `BitshifterMod.WhyYield` returns the reason the mod steps aside (Digital CPU enabled by Workshop id or `staticID`, or a contested method already patched by another Harmony owner). `OnAllModsLoaded` logs `Disabled: <reason>` and skips `PatchAll`.
- `OverlayLabelGuard.Apply` runs even when the mod yields, and only when Better Automation Overlay is present (`AccessTools.TypeByName` returns null otherwise).
- `LogicGate_UpdateState_Patch` expects exactly one four-bit mask; any other count logs a warning and leaves the NOT gate unchanged.
- `Display.UseAnim` warns and keeps the vanilla art when its kanim is missing.

## Related
**Id:** blk-b886a0e7283a

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

---

description: "File, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming for Bitshifter (project Bitshifter)."
applies_to:

---
# Naming Conventions

## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-9ddf389e7bd5

### General Rules
**Id:** blk-f7f89d69f1fd

- A mod lives in `mods/<kebab-case-name>/` (`natural-backwalls-everywhere`, `just-fall-already`).
- Its code is under `mods/<name>/src/<PascalName>/` with a matching `src/<PascalName>.Tests/` project. `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and the project folder share one PascalCase name (`DontCountEggsOnRails`).
- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold. One concept per file; small related types may share a file (`Display` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Release tags are `<mod-folder>-v<version>` (repository README).

### Examples by Type
**Id:** blk-dfc2718274e5

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Mod entry class | `Mod.cs`, class `<Name>Mod : UserMod2` | `BitshifterMod` in `Mod.cs` |
| Harmony patches | `Patches.cs`, or a file named for what is patched | `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `SettleSimPatch.cs` |
| Building config | `<Building>Config.cs`, class `<Building>Config : IBuildingConfig` with `public const string ID` | `SmartWeightPlateConfig.cs` |
| Side screen | `<Building>SideScreen.cs` | `SmartWeightPlateSideScreen.cs` |
| Components | `<Thing>.cs` named for the component | `FridgeThermostat.cs`, `ZoneStore.cs` |
| Strings | `ModStrings.cs` | `mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/ModStrings.cs` |
| Options | `Options.cs`, class `Options` | `mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs` |
| Tests | `<Topic>.cs` in `<Name>.Tests`, one static class per topic | `Reach.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `Persistence.cs`; `Kit.cs` for shared helpers |
| Mod metadata | `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml` in the project folder | `staticID: "Isochronous.<PascalName>"` |
| Translations | `translations/<locale>.po`, template `<Name>.pot` | `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/translations` |
| Art | `anim/` (kanim files), `assets/` | `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim` |
| Release material | `mods/<name>/publish/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` | |

## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-e9a0e27902f2

### Variables
**Id:** blk-9bc5907f3229

- camelCase for locals, parameters and private instance fields; no underscore prefix.
- PascalCase for constants (`ArmSeconds`, `Bits`, `TechId`) and for `static readonly` values that act as constants or lookups (`Standard`, `YieldToWorkshopIds`, `Contested`).
- camelCase for private static mutable state and caches (`armed`, `scratch`, `lastGrid`, `symbols`, `anyRows`).
- Descriptive names; single letters only for loop indexes and the `e` of a catch.

```csharp
private const float ArmSeconds = 2f;
private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> armed = new Dictionary<int, float>();
```
(`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`)

### Functions/Methods
**Id:** blk-180ca76feb4d

- PascalCase, starting with a verb: `Apply`, `Decide`, `SwapTable`, `CopyRangeFrom`, `ApplyRange`.
- Game callbacks keep the game's names (`OnSpawn`, `OnPrefabInit`, `OnCleanUp`, `Sim1000ms`).
- Harmony methods are named for their kind: `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler`, `Finalizer`, plus `Prepare`, `TargetMethod`, `TargetMethods`.

### Classes/Types/Interfaces
**Id:** blk-3e57e6b713fd

- PascalCase nouns. Interfaces take an `I` prefix (`IPlanTab` and `ITabView` in `mods/upgrade-planner`, and the game's own).
- Harmony patch classes: `<PatchedType>_<PatchedMethod>_Patch` (`LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `Db_Initialize_Patch`, `GeneratedBuildings_LoadGeneratedBuildings_Patch`). A patch for a type with one concern may use `<Type>_Patch` (`LiquidVentConfig_Patch`). Patches nested in a holder class may drop the suffix (`Constructable_OnSpawn` in `ReachTablePatches`).
- Classes are `sealed` unless built for inheritance. The mod class is `public sealed`. Types the game does not reach are `internal`.
- Option enums and nested helper types are PascalCase (`CoolPodMode`, `BridgeKind`).

### Booleans
**Id:** blk-da8548cd28fd

- Prefix with `Is`, `Has`, `Can`, `Should` or name the state: `IsEnabled`, `OriginalActive`, `isSpawned`, `warnedMissingInternals`.

### Strings (`ModStrings`)
**Id:** blk-ade5b1028345

- `ModStrings` mirrors the game's `STRINGS` tree: nested static classes and `LocString` fields in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. `ModStrings.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME` is registered as `STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME`, the key the game looks a building name up by (`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/ModStrings.cs`).
- Mod-private text goes under a branch named for the mod in capitals (`ModStrings.SALTYSURF.ELEMENT_LIST`, `ModStrings.JUMPERBRIDGES.OPTIONS`).
- Option keys are written out as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.<OPTION>.NAME` and `.TOOLTIP`; categories as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.CATEGORY.<NAME>`.
- Long branches are shortened with an alias at the top of the file (`using OPTIONS = NaturalBackwalls.ModStrings.NATURALBACKWALLS.OPTIONS;`).

### Ids and Tags
**Id:** blk-9e8a58496cc9

- Building ids are PascalCase and match the config class (`SmartWeightPlate`); a mod that replaces another mod's buildings reuses that mod's ids (`StoragePodConfig`, `CoolPodConfig` in `mods/storage-pod-redux`).
- Tags and PAction ids carry a mod prefix: `DetectAnyElement_Any`, `Isochronous.SweepZones.Tool`.
- The `staticID` in `mod.yaml` is `Isochronous.<PascalName>`.
- Test names start with the mod's name or an abbreviation of it: `[OniTest("Bitshifter: a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts every bit")]`, `VFF:` for Vent Freeze Fix.

## Project-Specific Conventions
**Id:** blk-d7f1354ce00e

### Bitshifter specifics
**Id:** blk-3e9cd9430502

- Patch classes: `LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `LogicGate_UpdateState_Patch`, and so on, all `<Type>_<Method>_Patch`.
- `BitshifterMod.Bits` is the one constant for the bit count (31); the kanims are `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim` and `bitshifter_ribbon_writer_kanim` (`Display.ReaderAnim`, `Display.WriterAnim`).
- Log prefix `[Bitshifter]`; `staticID` `Isochronous.Bitshifter`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-9e0cf6b41f53

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

witness_digest: "sha256:0306519df41aa63a1a600c61bb32b39a0b3a095827e6365f9dd180909f6c8a3f"
witness: loose
applies_to:

description: "Entities, business rules and key code paths of corner-build-anything: reach-table swap for construction and deconstruction"

# Corner Build Anything domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-5eaa0c4a7e12

Corner Build Anything lets duplicants build and deconstruct any building through a diagonal gap, the way the game already lets them build tiles. It adds no buildings, options or saved state; it changes which reach table two game methods use. Source is in `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-649a6e358fea

### OffsetGroups reach tables
**Id:** blk-21f0d61743aa  
**Description**: The game keeps two tables of offsets that say where a duplicant may stand to work on a building. `InvertedStandardTable` reaches a diagonal cell only by way of one of its two orthogonal neighbours. `InvertedStandardTableWithCorners` reaches diagonal cells outright. The corner table is a strict superset of the standard one: every standing cell the standard table reaches, it reaches, by the same or a shorter row of intermediate cells.  
**Location**: game class `OffsetGroups` (not in this repo); the mod reads both as static fields in `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`

**Relationships**: `OffsetGroups.BuildReachabilityTable` caches by table reference, so the swapped table gets its own cache entries and does not collide with a mod that still asks for the standard one.

### Constructable.OnSpawn patch
**Id:** blk-b8025016d218  
**Description**: Transpiler that replaces every `ldsfld OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable` in `Constructable.OnSpawn` with a load of the corner table. The game picks the corner table here for tiles only; after the patch every building gets it.  
**Location**: `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs` (`Constructable_OnSpawn`)

### Deconstructable.OnSpawn patch
**Id:** blk-ba96c6ad3eb0  
**Description**: The same transpiler on `Deconstructable.OnSpawn`, so a building put up through a corner can be taken down through the same corner.  
**Location**: `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs` (`Deconstructable_OnSpawn`)

### SwapTable
**Id:** blk-1b351a36e13a  
**Description**: The shared instruction rewrite. Counts the swapped loads, logs `corner reach table in place` per method, or logs a warning and leaves the method unchanged when it no longer loads the standard table.  
**Location**: `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`

### CornerBuildAnythingMod
**Id:** blk-b1cf9481a19b  
**Description**: The `UserMod2` entry point. Calls `base.OnLoad` (which applies all patches) and logs the version.  
**Location**: `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/Mod.cs`

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-5fd39b686cad

- Duplicants may build and deconstruct any building from a corner standing cell, not only tiles.
- Multi-cell buildings, bridges included, are covered by the same swap: the game builds their reach from every footprint cell, taking the rows of the nearest footprint cell to the standing cell, so a bridge is reachable through a corner from either end and its middle. No bridge-specific patch exists.
- Placement rules are unchanged: what can be placed where is exactly as before. Only who can reach it once placed changes.
- Rotation, a building's own offset filter (the cells it refuses to be worked from, for example a pressure plate) and the delivery storage that shares the construction table keep the game's values, so materials arrive through the corner too.
- The change only adds reachable positions; it never removes one.
- A game update that stops either method loading the standard table does not fail the patch; the method is left as is and a warning is logged.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-3ccd0caf0b17

- **Build through a corner**: `Constructable.OnSpawn` reads the corner table (patched) — see `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`
- **Deconstruct through a corner**: `Deconstructable.OnSpawn` reads the corner table (patched) — see the same file
- **Tests**: in-game tests in `mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything.Tests/`: `Reach.cs` (table loads, reach checks, controls, superset check, placement unchanged), `Pockets.cs` (pocket fixtures), `ByHand.cs` (duplicants build a switch, a 2x2 generator and a bridge end through corners and take them down)

## Related
**Id:** blk-01a371e4fdff

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Domain Glossary

Terms used in the Corner Build Anything mod (`mods/corner-build-anything`). For the classes and patches behind them, see the entities document.

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-6df20dc29a0d

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod is for |
| OnSpawn | Component spawn callback | `Constructable.OnSpawn` and `Deconstructable.OnSpawn` are the two patched methods |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-8812a9239a96

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Corner placement | Corner reach | The mod changes who can reach a building once placed; what can be placed where is unchanged |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-831d591151c9

### Reach table
**Id:** blk-2e755327158e  
**Definition**: A table of offsets that says where a duplicant may stand to work on a building. The game keeps two: standard and with corners.  
**Used in**: `OffsetGroups`, both patches

### Standard table
**Id:** blk-b85705fc1357  
**Definition**: `OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable`. A diagonal cell is reachable only by way of one of its two orthogonal neighbours.  
**Used in**: the game's setup for non-tile buildings; the mod's `Standard` field

### Corner table
**Id:** blk-61683cf3e067  
**Definition**: `OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTableWithCorners`. Diagonal cells are reachable outright. The game uses it for digging and for tiles; the mod makes every building use it.  
**Used in**: the mod's `WithCorners` field

### Corner pocket
**Id:** blk-0666a699ad10  
**Definition**: A cell whose only opening is a diagonal gap. Under the standard table it is out of reach for building, so it can be dug and tiled but not laddered or piped.  
**Used in**: `Pockets.cs` in the tests

### Footprint
**Id:** blk-cc24605602b3  
**Definition**: All the cells a building occupies. A multi-cell building's reach is built from every footprint cell, using the rows of the one nearest the standing cell.  
**Used in**: bridge handling, `Reach.cs` tests

### Offset filter
**Id:** blk-9c225ac82915  
**Definition**: A building's own list of cells it refuses to be worked from (a pressure plate, for example). The mod leaves it as the game sets it.  
**Used in**: the pressure plate control test in `Reach.cs`

### Standing cell
**Id:** blk-d7404ebb59b2  
**Definition**: The cell a duplicant stands in to work on a building.  
**Used in**: reach checks

## Related
**Id:** blk-79d498f02cc9

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# corner-build-anything

## What this is
**Id:** blk-80ead4e4d699

Corner Build Anything is an Oxygen Not Included mod that lets duplicants build and deconstruct any building through a diagonal gap, the way the game already lets them build tiles. Bridges of every kind count from either end, not just their middle. It swaps the reach table that Constructable and Deconstructable use when a building spawns. Version 0.1.0 in `mod_info.yaml`, minimum supported build 744825; the changelog lists it as Unreleased and the node holds no Workshop id.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-775902750f85

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/CornerBuildAnything/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point), `ReachTablePatches.cs` (the Constructable and Deconstructable reach-table swap), `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/CornerBuildAnything.Tests/`: in-game tests (`Reach.cs`, `Pockets.cs`, `ByHand.cs`).
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description and tags.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

---
doc_id: doc-5d79dd719a71
description: "C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions for Corner Build Anything (makes duplicants reach buildings from diagonal corners), with this mod's own layout."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-997822456e5d

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-7b1361387080

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-a92de9fa26ec

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-d28ac43fbcdb

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-e1e99df9f199

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-748fc9985831

### Organization
**Id:** blk-af16ffcd943c

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-431be121fc8c

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-34567b821480

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-b19160e035af

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-606e426f80cf

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-693adf4828c6

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-27f2a339c877

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-817cd2a98a1e

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-c6278ac1655d

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-968f3a86b207

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-1ebc400095cd

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-3c9f317e1942

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-ae5190625f1d

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Corner Build Anything specifics
**Id:** blk-7a0bd3890da4

- The mod is two transpilers over one shared method. They are nested in `internal static class ReachTablePatches` (`src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`) and call `SwapTable(instructions, original)`.
- No PLib, no translations, no options; `Mod.cs` only logs the version.
- `ReachTablePatches.cs` uses `var` for the instruction list, one of the few places in production code.

## Related
**Id:** blk-2f0e144efce8

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-bec2d98ee48a
description: "How Corner Build Anything guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Error Handling Conventions

## Principles
**Id:** blk-ff2bf3b4f17f

1. **Never break the game for a mod's sake.** A patch that cannot do its job leaves the vanilla behaviour in place and says so in the log. It does not throw into the game's update loop.
2. **Check what you patch.** Game updates rename fields and move code. Every reflection lookup, transpiler match and prefab or tech lookup is checked for a miss.
3. **Say what degraded.** A warning names the thing that was not found and the consequence, so a bug report with `Player.log` is enough to diagnose.
4. **Don't swallow.** A `catch` logs and either returns a safe default or continues; it is never empty.
5. **Log at the right level.** `Debug.Log` for start-up and summaries, `Debug.LogWarning` for degraded behaviour, `Debug.LogError` for a failed player action.

There is no custom exception hierarchy. Mods are small patches over game code, so errors are handled where they occur.

## Guarding Patches
**Id:** blk-a806354c0ca6

### Missing member: warn, leave vanilla
**Id:** blk-3246f83ea12b

A reflection lookup that returns null is checked before use. The patch then does nothing, or returns `true` from a prefix so the game's method runs.

```csharp
if (ActiveField == null || StorageField == null)
	return true; // the game renamed its fields: leave vanilla alone rather than throw
```
(`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/Patches.cs`; the warning is logged once at load by `SimTransferMethod` in `FridgeThermostat.cs`.)

### Transpiler: count the match
**Id:** blk-101f4f9d4623

A transpiler counts the instructions it replaced. Zero (or more than expected) logs a warning and returns the original code, so a game update disables the change instead of breaking the method.

```csharp
if (swapped == 0)
	Debug.LogWarning("[CornerBuildAnything] " + where + " does not load OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable; corner reach not applied there");
```
(`mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`; same pattern in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` and `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`.)

### Missing data: warn, continue
**Id:** blk-da49810c7ea2

A build-menu, tech or asset lookup that finds nothing warns and keeps the mod working:

```csharp
Tech tech = Db.Get().Techs.TryGet(TechId);
if (tech == null)
{
	Debug.LogWarning("[SmartWeightPlate] Tech '" + TechId + "' not found; building will be unlocked from the start");
	return;
}
```
(`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Patches.cs`; also `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor`, `mods/storage-pod-redux`.) Missing art or a missing vanilla prefab degrades the same way (`Display.UseAnim` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`, `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor/src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`).

### Null checks on game objects
**Id:** blk-fcfa7d5a5167

Components and arguments that can be absent are tested before use: `if (stt == null || !Sim.IsValidHandle(stt.SimHandle)) return true;`, `if (sensor == null || GameScenePartitioner.Instance == null) return;` (`mods/motion-sensor-range/src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`).

### Warn once
**Id:** blk-68f2815379e6

Work that repeats every frame or tick warns once behind a flag (`warnedMissingInternals` in `RangeSlider.cs`).

## try/catch
**Id:** blk-e5aba18fd731

`try`/`catch (Exception e)` is used in four situations and nowhere else:

1. **Optional integration with another mod.** Patching or reading another mod's types may fail for any reason. Log the message and skip the integration (`BetterAutomationOverlayCompat.Apply` in `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`; `mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Compat/BlueprintsCompat.cs`).
2. **File and JSON reads and writes.** Return an empty or null result (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan/Presets.cs`, `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/ModDetection.cs`, `mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ToolIcon.cs`).
3. **Patches that run inside worldgen or per-cell work**, where an escaping exception kills a thread or a whole pass (`mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/FeaturePatch.cs`, `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `Census.cs`).
4. **Per-job work in a queue**, so one failure does not stop the rest (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Tool/PlacementQueue.cs`, logged with `Debug.LogError`).

The message form is `"[<Name>] <what was skipped>: " + e.Message`. Use `e.GetBaseException().Message` when the exception may be a reflection wrapper, and the full `e` when the stack trace is needed.

### Finalizer for a thread with no handler
**Id:** blk-e5797c076f0c

`Cluster.BeginGeneration` is the worldgen thread body and has none; an exception ends the thread and the loading screen waits forever. A finalizer reports the failure through the game's own error path and logs the exception (`Cluster_BeginGeneration_Patch` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/WorldgenThreadPatch.cs`).

## Yielding to Other Mods
**Id:** blk-ae05b9df7071

When another mod already does the job or shares an id, the mod steps aside and logs why:
- Bitshifter disables itself when Digital CPU is enabled or the contested methods already have Harmony owners (`WhyYield` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Storage Pod Redux does not register its buildings while the original Storage Pod is enabled, and logs a warning telling the player to disable one (`mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Mod.cs`).

## Logging
**Id:** blk-3c1abb664829

### Log Levels
**Id:** blk-2519a49b0e5f

| Level | Use For | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `Debug.LogError` | A player action failed and was abandoned | `PlacementQueue` in `mods/upgrade-planner` |
| `Debug.LogWarning` | Degraded or skipped behaviour | the examples above |
| `Debug.Log` | Load line, a one-line summary of what a pass changed | `Tagged N refined metal(s)` in `mods/refined-building` |

### What to Include
**Id:** blk-738df9dacdf7

- The `[<ModName>] ` prefix on every line; `JumperBridgesMod.LogPrefix` holds it for that mod.
- What was expected, what was found, and what the mod does instead.
- Cell numbers, building names and element ids when they identify the case (`mods/vent-freeze-fix`).
- Per-tick or per-frame telemetry only behind a debug option (`VentFreezeWatcher.Verbose`, `DebugSave.Enabled`) or capped (`DetailLines` in `SettleSimPatch.cs`).

PLib's `PUtil.Log*` helpers are not used; all mods log through `Debug`.

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
**Id:** blk-5bc0b9c40252

### Swallowing exceptions
**Id:** blk-f9d4eb421dfe

An empty `catch` hides a broken patch. The one `catch` that returns a fallback without a log is `GuessLanguageCode` in `common/src/Translations.cs`, because a missing language preference is the normal case before the game has started.

### Throwing from a patch
**Id:** blk-0be6d9e365d6

An exception in a prefix or postfix on a per-frame or sim method repeats every frame. Guard, log once, return.

### Assuming the game's internals
**Id:** blk-b84f941bdb22

Reading a private field by name without a null check on the `FieldInfo`, or replacing an instruction without confirming it was found, breaks on the next game update.

### Silent degradation
**Id:** blk-9aeff1954315

Doing nothing without a log line leaves a player and the author guessing. Every skipped path logs.

### Spamming the log
**Id:** blk-95478e1309d9

A warning inside an update method fires thousands of times. Use a once-flag.

## Project-Specific Patterns
**Id:** blk-d861a9eb5703

### Corner Build Anything specifics
**Id:** blk-be6bc503e715

- `SwapTable` counts the loads of `OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable` it replaced. Zero logs a warning naming `<Type>.<Method>` and returns the code unchanged; otherwise it logs that the corner table is in place.
- The transpilers run once at patch time, so there is no run-time guard.

## Related
**Id:** blk-0f671bedac9c

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-45341a356366
description: "File, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming for Corner Build Anything (project CornerBuildAnything)."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Naming Conventions

## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-5c12daff78c6

### General Rules
**Id:** blk-d1d72406d603

- A mod lives in `mods/<kebab-case-name>/` (`natural-backwalls-everywhere`, `just-fall-already`).
- Its code is under `mods/<name>/src/<PascalName>/` with a matching `src/<PascalName>.Tests/` project. `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and the project folder share one PascalCase name (`DontCountEggsOnRails`).
- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold. One concept per file; small related types may share a file (`Display` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Release tags are `<mod-folder>-v<version>` (repository README).

### Examples by Type
**Id:** blk-c963897629f3

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Mod entry class | `Mod.cs`, class `<Name>Mod : UserMod2` | `BitshifterMod` in `Mod.cs` |
| Harmony patches | `Patches.cs`, or a file named for what is patched | `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `SettleSimPatch.cs` |
| Building config | `<Building>Config.cs`, class `<Building>Config : IBuildingConfig` with `public const string ID` | `SmartWeightPlateConfig.cs` |
| Side screen | `<Building>SideScreen.cs` | `SmartWeightPlateSideScreen.cs` |
| Components | `<Thing>.cs` named for the component | `FridgeThermostat.cs`, `ZoneStore.cs` |
| Strings | `ModStrings.cs` | `mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/ModStrings.cs` |
| Options | `Options.cs`, class `Options` | `mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs` |
| Tests | `<Topic>.cs` in `<Name>.Tests`, one static class per topic | `Reach.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `Persistence.cs`; `Kit.cs` for shared helpers |
| Mod metadata | `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml` in the project folder | `staticID: "Isochronous.<PascalName>"` |
| Translations | `translations/<locale>.po`, template `<Name>.pot` | `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/translations` |
| Art | `anim/` (kanim files), `assets/` | `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim` |
| Release material | `mods/<name>/publish/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` | |

## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-092208e522d6

### Variables
**Id:** blk-2aba30d1f782

- camelCase for locals, parameters and private instance fields; no underscore prefix.
- PascalCase for constants (`ArmSeconds`, `Bits`, `TechId`) and for `static readonly` values that act as constants or lookups (`Standard`, `YieldToWorkshopIds`, `Contested`).
- camelCase for private static mutable state and caches (`armed`, `scratch`, `lastGrid`, `symbols`, `anyRows`).
- Descriptive names; single letters only for loop indexes and the `e` of a catch.

```csharp
private const float ArmSeconds = 2f;
private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> armed = new Dictionary<int, float>();
```
(`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`)

### Functions/Methods
**Id:** blk-f2eb35a7a254

- PascalCase, starting with a verb: `Apply`, `Decide`, `SwapTable`, `CopyRangeFrom`, `ApplyRange`.
- Game callbacks keep the game's names (`OnSpawn`, `OnPrefabInit`, `OnCleanUp`, `Sim1000ms`).
- Harmony methods are named for their kind: `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler`, `Finalizer`, plus `Prepare`, `TargetMethod`, `TargetMethods`.

### Classes/Types/Interfaces
**Id:** blk-04a530477b1f

- PascalCase nouns. Interfaces take an `I` prefix (`IPlanTab` and `ITabView` in `mods/upgrade-planner`, and the game's own).
- Harmony patch classes: `<PatchedType>_<PatchedMethod>_Patch` (`LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `Db_Initialize_Patch`, `GeneratedBuildings_LoadGeneratedBuildings_Patch`). A patch for a type with one concern may use `<Type>_Patch` (`LiquidVentConfig_Patch`). Patches nested in a holder class may drop the suffix (`Constructable_OnSpawn` in `ReachTablePatches`).
- Classes are `sealed` unless built for inheritance. The mod class is `public sealed`. Types the game does not reach are `internal`.
- Option enums and nested helper types are PascalCase (`CoolPodMode`, `BridgeKind`).

### Booleans
**Id:** blk-768631ca72e2

- Prefix with `Is`, `Has`, `Can`, `Should` or name the state: `IsEnabled`, `OriginalActive`, `isSpawned`, `warnedMissingInternals`.

### Strings (`ModStrings`)
**Id:** blk-9026e3de62b9

- `ModStrings` mirrors the game's `STRINGS` tree: nested static classes and `LocString` fields in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. `ModStrings.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME` is registered as `STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME`, the key the game looks a building name up by (`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/ModStrings.cs`).
- Mod-private text goes under a branch named for the mod in capitals (`ModStrings.SALTYSURF.ELEMENT_LIST`, `ModStrings.JUMPERBRIDGES.OPTIONS`).
- Option keys are written out as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.<OPTION>.NAME` and `.TOOLTIP`; categories as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.CATEGORY.<NAME>`.
- Long branches are shortened with an alias at the top of the file (`using OPTIONS = NaturalBackwalls.ModStrings.NATURALBACKWALLS.OPTIONS;`).

### Ids and Tags
**Id:** blk-5c7309053335

- Building ids are PascalCase and match the config class (`SmartWeightPlate`); a mod that replaces another mod's buildings reuses that mod's ids (`StoragePodConfig`, `CoolPodConfig` in `mods/storage-pod-redux`).
- Tags and PAction ids carry a mod prefix: `DetectAnyElement_Any`, `Isochronous.SweepZones.Tool`.
- The `staticID` in `mod.yaml` is `Isochronous.<PascalName>`.
- Test names start with the mod's name or an abbreviation of it: `[OniTest("Bitshifter: a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts every bit")]`, `VFF:` for Vent Freeze Fix.

## Project-Specific Conventions
**Id:** blk-62dc31bf6800

### Corner Build Anything specifics
**Id:** blk-8ab8f88f3345

- Nested patch classes are named for the patched type and method without the `_Patch` suffix: `Constructable_OnSpawn`, `Deconstructable_OnSpawn`.
- The two `FieldInfo` lookups are PascalCase `static readonly` fields (`Standard`, `WithCorners`).
- Log prefix `[CornerBuildAnything]`; `staticID` `Isochronous.CornerBuildAnything`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-53eea0f7f442

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

# Detect Any Element domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-3e95a3354643

Detect Any Element adds an Any choice, directly under None, to the side screen of the five element sensors. On Any a sensor is on while anything at all is present, and its screen flashes an asterisk. The choice is a tag in the sensor's `Filterable`, so it is saved and copied like an element. Source is in `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-eae9be288da3

### AnyElement
**Id:** blk-e4bdbace6e5b  
**Description**: The Any choice. A `Tag` named `DetectAnyElement_Any`, created with the English name "Any" through `TagManager.Create`. It rides in the same saved `Filterable` field as element tags, so it is saved with the building and copied by copy-settings. Without the mod, a sensor saved on Any keeps the tag and matches nothing.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Mod.cs`

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| TagName | const string | `DetectAnyElement_Any` |
| Tag | Tag | The created tag |
| Is(tag) | bool | Whether a tag is Any |

**Relationships**: `DetectAnyElementMod.OnLoad` registers `ModStrings` with `Isochronous.Translations` and re-creates the tag with the translated name after every language pass, because the game keeps its own copy of a tag's proper name.

### ModStrings
**Id:** blk-f7cd1a1120d9  
**Description**: The mod's one string, `ModStrings.MISC.TAGS.DETECTANYELEMENT_ANY` ("Any"), registered under the game's `STRINGS.MISC.TAGS` and replaced from `translations/<locale>.po`. Chinese (Simplified), Korean and Russian ship; the template is `translations/DetectAnyElement.pot`.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/ModStrings.cs`

### FilterSideScreen.SetTarget patch
**Id:** blk-ee58ba77ae0e  
**Description**: Postfix that adds an Any row second in the list, under None, on screens with `isLogicFilter` (the pipe and rail element sensors and the in-world sensors; the conveyor and pipe filters keep only None). The row has its icon hidden, like None. The row is kept per screen in a `ConditionalWeakTable`, and selected when the target is already on Any.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs` (`FilterSideScreen_SetTarget_Patch`)

### ConduitElementSensor.ConduitUpdate patch
**Id:** blk-2c3758b48106  
**Description**: Prefix for the Liquid Pipe, Gas Pipe and Conveyor Rail Element Sensors. On Any the sensor is on while the conduit at its cell holds mass above zero (any packet, whatever the element or item); it toggles the switch to match and skips the game's element test.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs` (`ConduitElementSensor_ConduitUpdate_Patch`)

### LogicElementSensor.Sim200ms patch
**Id:** blk-1687ce1b77e2  
**Description**: Prefix for the in-world Gas and Liquid Element Sensors. On Any the sensor is on while its cell holds any element of its desired state (any gas, or any liquid; vacuum counts as nothing). It keeps the game's eight-sample steadiness window (`samples`, `sampleIdx`) and drops only the element test.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs` (`LogicElementSensor_Sim200ms_Patch`)

### LogicElementSensor.OnElementSelected patch
**Id:** blk-8499447d8b7f  
**Description**: Postfix that clears the "no element selected" status item when the choice is Any, since Any is a choice and not a lack of one.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs` (`LogicElementSensor_OnElementSelected_Patch`)

### AnyGlyph
**Id:** blk-e07d0d8f7399  
**Description**: `KMonoBehaviour` added to each of the five sensors. While the sensor is on Any it overrides the symbol `elements` (the icon the screen flashes when on) with an asterisk symbol from the mod's `detect_any_asterisk_kanim`, named `asterisk_<sensor kanim>`; each is in that icon's colour and offset to land mid-screen. Off or another choice removes the override. If the symbol is missing it logs a warning and the sensor keeps the vanilla icon.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/AnyGlyph.cs`

**Relationships**: needs `Filterable`, `SymbolOverrideController` and `KBatchedAnimController` on the same object; subscribes to `Filterable.onFilterChanged`.

### SensorConfigs_DoPostConfigureComplete_Patch
**Id:** blk-dd68a64821ad  
**Description**: Postfix on `DoPostConfigureComplete` of `LiquidConduitElementSensorConfig`, `GasConduitElementSensorConfig`, `SolidConduitElementSensorConfig`, `LogicElementSensorGasConfig` and `LogicElementSensorLiquidConfig`. Adds a `SymbolOverrideController` to the prefab when missing (it must exist before the anim controller is instantiated) and adds `AnyGlyph`.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/AnyGlyph.cs`

### Switches
**Id:** blk-014063748fa2  
**Description**: Delegate for the protected `Switch.Toggle`, which the sensors flip through.  
**Location**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-1a05232af13b

- Any appears right under None for the five element sensors only.
- A pipe or rail sensor on Any is green while any packet at all passes through it.
- An in-world Gas sensor on Any is green while its cell holds any gas; the Liquid sensor, any liquid. Vacuum counts as nothing.
- Picking an element switches Any off and picking Any switches the element off: a sensor has one choice at a time.
- The Any choice is saved with the building and copied with its settings.
- When a sensor on Any is on, its screen flashes an asterisk; when off, the screen looks as it always does.
- Everything else, including the eight-sample window, is the game's own logic with the element test removed.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-752306474b78

- **Choosing Any**: `FilterSideScreen.SetTarget` postfix adds the row; the filter change updates the `Filterable` tag and `AnyGlyph.OnFilterChanged` — see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs` and `AnyGlyph.cs`
- **Pipe and rail detection**: `ConduitElementSensor.ConduitUpdate` prefix — see `Patches.cs`
- **World detection**: `LogicElementSensor.Sim200ms` prefix — see `Patches.cs`
- **Asterisk art**: `tools/make_art.py` writes `src/DetectAnyElement/anim/assets/detect_any_asterisk/` using the Liberation Sans Bold asterisk (SIL Open Font License; font and licence are in `tools/`)
- **Tests**: `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement.Tests/` (`Glyph.cs`, `Kit.cs`, `Persistence.cs`, `PipeSensors.cs`, `SideScreen.cs`, `WorldSensors.cs`)

## Related
**Id:** blk-b067b1ae2cbb

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Domain Glossary

Terms used in the Detect Any Element mod (`mods/detect-any-element`). For the classes and patches behind them, see the entities document.

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-dd341ecb4ff1

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod is for |
| kanim | Klei animation | The game's sprite-animation asset; the mod ships `detect_any_asterisk_kanim` |
| .po / .pot | Gettext translation file / template | `translations/<locale>.po` and `DetectAnyElement.pot` |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-567dd4463017

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Wildcard, All | Any | The side screen row, the tag and the README all say Any |
| Element (for the Any choice) | Choice | Any is a tag in the filter, not an element; "no element selected" must not show for it |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-872dc2eafe6c

### Any
**Id:** blk-c8ba999de59d  
**Definition**: The extra choice under None in an element sensor's side screen; the sensor is on while anything is present.  
**Used in**: `AnyElement`, `FilterSideScreen_SetTarget_Patch`

### Element sensor
**Id:** blk-e193fc931720  
**Definition**: One of five automation sensors that switch on when a chosen element is present: Liquid Pipe, Gas Pipe and Conveyor Rail Element Sensors (`ConduitElementSensor`), and the in-world Gas and Liquid Element Sensors (`LogicElementSensor`).  
**Used in**: all patches

### Filterable
**Id:** blk-ba979d320f69  
**Definition**: The component that holds a building's chosen tag (`SelectedTag`) and saves it. The Any tag is stored here like an element tag.  
**Used in**: `AnyElement`, `AnyGlyph`, the sensor patches

### Tag
**Id:** blk-4a8dea407a48  
**Definition**: The game's `Tag` identifier, used for elements, categories and filter choices. `DetectAnyElement_Any` is the mod's tag, with a proper name "Any".  
**Used in**: `AnyElement`, `ModStrings`

### FilterSideScreen
**Id:** blk-d8ac2b48b1c5  
**Definition**: The details-panel screen listing None and element categories for a filtering building. `isLogicFilter` is true for the sensors; the conveyor and pipe filters keep only None.  
**Used in**: `FilterSideScreen_SetTarget_Patch`

### Conduit
**Id:** blk-691ec378450d  
**Definition**: A pipe or rail cell that carries a packet; the pipe sensors read the contents at their own cell.  
**Used in**: `ConduitElementSensor_ConduitUpdate_Patch`

### Steadiness window
**Id:** blk-ada7d73ad87a  
**Definition**: The in-world sensors' eight samples (every 200 ms) that must all agree before the switch changes, which stops flicker. Kept on Any.  
**Used in**: `LogicElementSensor_Sim200ms_Patch`

### Symbol override
**Id:** blk-8b1e59874671  
**Definition**: Replacing one named symbol of an animation at runtime (`SymbolOverrideController`). The sensor's `elements` symbol, the flashing icon, is replaced by the asterisk.  
**Used in**: `AnyGlyph`

## Related
**Id:** blk-aa8fba331ade

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# detect-any-element

## What this is
**Id:** blk-d74e1e7b3ec3

Detect Any Element is an Oxygen Not Included mod that adds an Any choice, right under None, to the element sensors. The Liquid Pipe, Gas Pipe and Conveyor Rail Element Sensors go green for any packet passing through, and the Gas and Liquid Element Sensors for any gas or liquid in their cell. Picking an element switches the sensor back to normal. The Any choice carries an asterisk drawn by a small kanim. Version 0.2.1 in `mod_info.yaml` (released 2026-10-12), minimum supported build 744825, published on the Steam Workshop with Korean, Russian and Chinese translations.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-a4375e886775

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/DetectAnyElement/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point and the Any tag), `Patches.cs` (side screen, pipe and world sensor patches), `AnyGlyph.cs` (the asterisk behaviour), `ModStrings.cs` (translatable strings), `anim/` (asterisk art), `translations/` (`.pot` and `.po` files), `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/DetectAnyElement.Tests/`: in-game tests for the glyph, persistence, pipe sensors, side screen and world sensors.
- `tools/make_art.py`: generates the asterisk art; `tools/` also holds the Liberation Sans font and its licence.
- `preview/`: preview image source.
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and the packaged mod.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

---
doc_id: doc-57f3985fd9e2
description: "C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions for Detect Any Element (adds an Any choice to the element sensors), with this mod's own layout."
applies_to:
