# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-c6a72ffc816e

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-1d2cc304e9de

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-10505badb72b

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-5658a6640d6f

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-568c3162f3c6

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-7a0b494a2a9e

### Organization
**Id:** blk-a3ab7baa9b9b

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-6a8bea597750

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-3309b637ae29

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-6e6c7ccc6bba

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-1ac432e22516

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-6d1f7ad40920

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-49ddba822c4b

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-71a3fd333369

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-a138faf04479

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-c279f0f84eb1

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-568d224900b6

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-c8c4aaafedc9

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-d691a716fef2

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Detect Any Element specifics
**Id:** blk-75650a2c420e

- Uses `UseTranslations` and `ReferenceUnityUI`; no PLib. `Mod.cs` registers `ModStrings` and passes an `afterApply` callback that re-sets the "Any" tag's proper name after every language pass (`src/DetectAnyElement/Mod.cs`).
- `AnyElement` is a public static class in `Mod.cs`: the tag, its name and `Is(Tag)`.
- `Patches.cs` holds the side-screen and sensor patches (`FilterSideScreen_SetTarget_Patch`, `ConduitElementSensor_ConduitUpdate_Patch`, `LogicElementSensor_Sim200ms_Patch`, `LogicElementSensor_OnElementSelected_Patch`) plus the small internal helper `Switches`. `AnyGlyph.cs` holds the glyph component and `SensorConfigs_DoPostConfigureComplete_Patch`, a multi-target patch with `TargetMethods()` that yields the five sensor configs.
- `ConditionalWeakTable` is the per-screen cache (`anyRows`); the game's .NET Framework has no `AddOrUpdate`, so the code removes and adds.

## Related
**Id:** blk-1578bbc82bf2

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-536d0bdee6af
description: "How Detect Any Element guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Error Handling Conventions

## Principles
**Id:** blk-1c12fcb172de

1. **Never break the game for a mod's sake.** A patch that cannot do its job leaves the vanilla behaviour in place and says so in the log. It does not throw into the game's update loop.
2. **Check what you patch.** Game updates rename fields and move code. Every reflection lookup, transpiler match and prefab or tech lookup is checked for a miss.
3. **Say what degraded.** A warning names the thing that was not found and the consequence, so a bug report with `Player.log` is enough to diagnose.
4. **Don't swallow.** A `catch` logs and either returns a safe default or continues; it is never empty.
5. **Log at the right level.** `Debug.Log` for start-up and summaries, `Debug.LogWarning` for degraded behaviour, `Debug.LogError` for a failed player action.

There is no custom exception hierarchy. Mods are small patches over game code, so errors are handled where they occur.

## Guarding Patches
**Id:** blk-4ef3aa08558c

### Missing member: warn, leave vanilla
**Id:** blk-49d91e817362

A reflection lookup that returns null is checked before use. The patch then does nothing, or returns `true` from a prefix so the game's method runs.

```csharp
if (ActiveField == null || StorageField == null)
	return true; // the game renamed its fields: leave vanilla alone rather than throw
```
(`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/Patches.cs`; the warning is logged once at load by `SimTransferMethod` in `FridgeThermostat.cs`.)

### Transpiler: count the match
**Id:** blk-4300a4469703

A transpiler counts the instructions it replaced. Zero (or more than expected) logs a warning and returns the original code, so a game update disables the change instead of breaking the method.

```csharp
if (swapped == 0)
	Debug.LogWarning("[CornerBuildAnything] " + where + " does not load OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable; corner reach not applied there");
```
(`mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`; same pattern in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` and `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`.)

### Missing data: warn, continue
**Id:** blk-bfbab614ef56

A build-menu, tech or asset lookup that finds nothing warns and keeps the mod working:

```csharp
Tech tech = Db.Get().Techs.TryGet(TechId);
if (tech == null)
{
	Debug.LogWarning("[SmartWeightPlate] Tech '" + TechId + "' not found; building will be unlocked from the start");
	return;
}
```
(`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Patches.cs`; also `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor`, `mods/storage-pod-redux`.) Missing art or a missing vanilla prefab degrades the same way (`Display.UseAnim` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`, `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor/src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`).

### Null checks on game objects
**Id:** blk-1a260b7c2cae

Components and arguments that can be absent are tested before use: `if (stt == null || !Sim.IsValidHandle(stt.SimHandle)) return true;`, `if (sensor == null || GameScenePartitioner.Instance == null) return;` (`mods/motion-sensor-range/src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`).

### Warn once
**Id:** blk-b4bf81744840

Work that repeats every frame or tick warns once behind a flag (`warnedMissingInternals` in `RangeSlider.cs`).

## try/catch
**Id:** blk-0a2a9b61cd78

`try`/`catch (Exception e)` is used in four situations and nowhere else:

1. **Optional integration with another mod.** Patching or reading another mod's types may fail for any reason. Log the message and skip the integration (`BetterAutomationOverlayCompat.Apply` in `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`; `mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Compat/BlueprintsCompat.cs`).
2. **File and JSON reads and writes.** Return an empty or null result (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan/Presets.cs`, `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/ModDetection.cs`, `mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ToolIcon.cs`).
3. **Patches that run inside worldgen or per-cell work**, where an escaping exception kills a thread or a whole pass (`mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/FeaturePatch.cs`, `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `Census.cs`).
4. **Per-job work in a queue**, so one failure does not stop the rest (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Tool/PlacementQueue.cs`, logged with `Debug.LogError`).

The message form is `"[<Name>] <what was skipped>: " + e.Message`. Use `e.GetBaseException().Message` when the exception may be a reflection wrapper, and the full `e` when the stack trace is needed.

### Finalizer for a thread with no handler
**Id:** blk-4bc5e76bb03f

`Cluster.BeginGeneration` is the worldgen thread body and has none; an exception ends the thread and the loading screen waits forever. A finalizer reports the failure through the game's own error path and logs the exception (`Cluster_BeginGeneration_Patch` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/WorldgenThreadPatch.cs`).

## Yielding to Other Mods
**Id:** blk-e1cb0e62cd50

When another mod already does the job or shares an id, the mod steps aside and logs why:
- Bitshifter disables itself when Digital CPU is enabled or the contested methods already have Harmony owners (`WhyYield` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Storage Pod Redux does not register its buildings while the original Storage Pod is enabled, and logs a warning telling the player to disable one (`mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Mod.cs`).

## Logging
**Id:** blk-1a532a50d7f2

### Log Levels
**Id:** blk-91679b3cf2ae

| Level | Use For | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `Debug.LogError` | A player action failed and was abandoned | `PlacementQueue` in `mods/upgrade-planner` |
| `Debug.LogWarning` | Degraded or skipped behaviour | the examples above |
| `Debug.Log` | Load line, a one-line summary of what a pass changed | `Tagged N refined metal(s)` in `mods/refined-building` |

### What to Include
**Id:** blk-6b7945999d4e

- The `[<ModName>] ` prefix on every line; `JumperBridgesMod.LogPrefix` holds it for that mod.
- What was expected, what was found, and what the mod does instead.
- Cell numbers, building names and element ids when they identify the case (`mods/vent-freeze-fix`).
- Per-tick or per-frame telemetry only behind a debug option (`VentFreezeWatcher.Verbose`, `DebugSave.Enabled`) or capped (`DetailLines` in `SettleSimPatch.cs`).

PLib's `PUtil.Log*` helpers are not used; all mods log through `Debug`.

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
**Id:** blk-f9f7ea4db024

### Swallowing exceptions
**Id:** blk-2e7d41dad80c

An empty `catch` hides a broken patch. The one `catch` that returns a fallback without a log is `GuessLanguageCode` in `common/src/Translations.cs`, because a missing language preference is the normal case before the game has started.

### Throwing from a patch
**Id:** blk-95922f65011e

An exception in a prefix or postfix on a per-frame or sim method repeats every frame. Guard, log once, return.

### Assuming the game's internals
**Id:** blk-0e85bde9ea93

Reading a private field by name without a null check on the `FieldInfo`, or replacing an instruction without confirming it was found, breaks on the next game update.

### Silent degradation
**Id:** blk-741ee95ad030

Doing nothing without a log line leaves a player and the author guessing. Every skipped path logs.

### Spamming the log
**Id:** blk-e1ff06290556

A warning inside an update method fires thousands of times. Use a once-flag.

## Project-Specific Patterns
**Id:** blk-cf2025fac0cc

### Detect Any Element specifics
**Id:** blk-683194568d75

- `AnyGlyph.Asterisk` looks a symbol up once, warns when the kanim has no such symbol, and returns null so the sensor keeps the vanilla icon (`src/DetectAnyElement/AnyGlyph.cs`).
- Patches return early when the screen is not the in-world filter (`isLogicFilter`) or `Filterable` is null.
- The `Any` tag rides in the sensor's saved `Filterable` field, so the mod's patches are the only code that gives it meaning (documented on `AnyElement`).

## Related
**Id:** blk-de9902f016fa

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

# Naming Conventions

## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-539807619278

### General Rules
**Id:** blk-77f2097ac8ef

- A mod lives in `mods/<kebab-case-name>/` (`natural-backwalls-everywhere`, `just-fall-already`).
- Its code is under `mods/<name>/src/<PascalName>/` with a matching `src/<PascalName>.Tests/` project. `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and the project folder share one PascalCase name (`DontCountEggsOnRails`).
- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold. One concept per file; small related types may share a file (`Display` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Release tags are `<mod-folder>-v<version>` (repository README).

### Examples by Type
**Id:** blk-701ebf962f66

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Mod entry class | `Mod.cs`, class `<Name>Mod : UserMod2` | `BitshifterMod` in `Mod.cs` |
| Harmony patches | `Patches.cs`, or a file named for what is patched | `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `SettleSimPatch.cs` |
| Building config | `<Building>Config.cs`, class `<Building>Config : IBuildingConfig` with `public const string ID` | `SmartWeightPlateConfig.cs` |
| Side screen | `<Building>SideScreen.cs` | `SmartWeightPlateSideScreen.cs` |
| Components | `<Thing>.cs` named for the component | `FridgeThermostat.cs`, `ZoneStore.cs` |
| Strings | `ModStrings.cs` | `mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/ModStrings.cs` |
| Options | `Options.cs`, class `Options` | `mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs` |
| Tests | `<Topic>.cs` in `<Name>.Tests`, one static class per topic | `Reach.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `Persistence.cs`; `Kit.cs` for shared helpers |
| Mod metadata | `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml` in the project folder | `staticID: "Isochronous.<PascalName>"` |
| Translations | `translations/<locale>.po`, template `<Name>.pot` | `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/translations` |
| Art | `anim/` (kanim files), `assets/` | `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim` |
| Release material | `mods/<name>/publish/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` | |

## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-65b1bbdec212

### Variables
**Id:** blk-b8840ab84c08

- camelCase for locals, parameters and private instance fields; no underscore prefix.
- PascalCase for constants (`ArmSeconds`, `Bits`, `TechId`) and for `static readonly` values that act as constants or lookups (`Standard`, `YieldToWorkshopIds`, `Contested`).
- camelCase for private static mutable state and caches (`armed`, `scratch`, `lastGrid`, `symbols`, `anyRows`).
- Descriptive names; single letters only for loop indexes and the `e` of a catch.

```csharp
private const float ArmSeconds = 2f;
private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> armed = new Dictionary<int, float>();
```
(`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`)

### Functions/Methods
**Id:** blk-dea9d87e5d99

- PascalCase, starting with a verb: `Apply`, `Decide`, `SwapTable`, `CopyRangeFrom`, `ApplyRange`.
- Game callbacks keep the game's names (`OnSpawn`, `OnPrefabInit`, `OnCleanUp`, `Sim1000ms`).
- Harmony methods are named for their kind: `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler`, `Finalizer`, plus `Prepare`, `TargetMethod`, `TargetMethods`.

### Classes/Types/Interfaces
**Id:** blk-886931b6c2d7

- PascalCase nouns. Interfaces take an `I` prefix (`IPlanTab` and `ITabView` in `mods/upgrade-planner`, and the game's own).
- Harmony patch classes: `<PatchedType>_<PatchedMethod>_Patch` (`LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `Db_Initialize_Patch`, `GeneratedBuildings_LoadGeneratedBuildings_Patch`). A patch for a type with one concern may use `<Type>_Patch` (`LiquidVentConfig_Patch`). Patches nested in a holder class may drop the suffix (`Constructable_OnSpawn` in `ReachTablePatches`).
- Classes are `sealed` unless built for inheritance. The mod class is `public sealed`. Types the game does not reach are `internal`.
- Option enums and nested helper types are PascalCase (`CoolPodMode`, `BridgeKind`).

### Booleans
**Id:** blk-29fd80f3e3d7

- Prefix with `Is`, `Has`, `Can`, `Should` or name the state: `IsEnabled`, `OriginalActive`, `isSpawned`, `warnedMissingInternals`.

### Strings (`ModStrings`)
**Id:** blk-fd1d164d62a1

- `ModStrings` mirrors the game's `STRINGS` tree: nested static classes and `LocString` fields in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. `ModStrings.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME` is registered as `STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME`, the key the game looks a building name up by (`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/ModStrings.cs`).
- Mod-private text goes under a branch named for the mod in capitals (`ModStrings.SALTYSURF.ELEMENT_LIST`, `ModStrings.JUMPERBRIDGES.OPTIONS`).
- Option keys are written out as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.<OPTION>.NAME` and `.TOOLTIP`; categories as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.CATEGORY.<NAME>`.
- Long branches are shortened with an alias at the top of the file (`using OPTIONS = NaturalBackwalls.ModStrings.NATURALBACKWALLS.OPTIONS;`).

### Ids and Tags
**Id:** blk-bb63ea5915af

- Building ids are PascalCase and match the config class (`SmartWeightPlate`); a mod that replaces another mod's buildings reuses that mod's ids (`StoragePodConfig`, `CoolPodConfig` in `mods/storage-pod-redux`).
- Tags and PAction ids carry a mod prefix: `DetectAnyElement_Any`, `Isochronous.SweepZones.Tool`.
- The `staticID` in `mod.yaml` is `Isochronous.<PascalName>`.
- Test names start with the mod's name or an abbreviation of it: `[OniTest("Bitshifter: a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts every bit")]`, `VFF:` for Vent Freeze Fix.

## Project-Specific Conventions
**Id:** blk-6f4976df4bad

### Detect Any Element specifics
**Id:** blk-5c798c858255

- `ModStrings` has one branch, `MISC.TAGS.DETECTANYELEMENT_ANY`, because the game keeps tag names under `STRINGS.MISC.TAGS`.
- The tag name is `DetectAnyElement_Any` (`AnyElement.TagName`); the glyph symbols are prefixed by the `AnyGlyph` constants `SymbolPrefix` and `KanimSuffix`.
- Log prefix `[DetectAnyElement]`; `staticID` `Isochronous.DetectAnyElement`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-879ba3cf8ae4

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

# Don't Count Eggs on Rails domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-233337a30535

Don't Count Eggs on Rails keeps critter sensors from counting eggs that are riding a conveyor rail. It adds no buildings, options or saved state: one Harmony prefix on the egg's room tracking. Source is in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-be406fb6be06

### OvercrowdingMonitor.UpdateRegion patch
**Id:** blk-e83dca4a52f5  
**Description**: A prefix on `OvercrowdingMonitor.UpdateRegion`, the once-a-second step in which an egg lists itself in the room its position falls in. For an egg on a rail it removes the egg from the room it was in and skips the original; for everything else it returns true and the game runs as usual.  
**Location**: `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` (`OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch`)

| Member | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| Prefix | bool | False when the egg is on a rail; also calls `smi.RemoveFromCavity()`, `roomProber.UpdateRoom(cavity)` and clears `smi.cavity` |
| OnRail | bool | The egg has `GameTags.Stored` and its `Pickupable.storage` is null |

**Relationships**: reads `OvercrowdingMonitor.Instance` (`IsEgg`, `cavity`, `kpid`); critter sensors count the eggs the room prober lists for their room, so unlisting the egg removes it from every sensor's count. Sensors, rails and the room prober are not patched.

### DontCountEggsOnRailsMod
**Id:** blk-549ca7135900  
**Description**: The `UserMod2` entry point. Calls `base.OnLoad` (which applies the patch) and logs the version.  
**Location**: `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs`

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-6376f81fca35

- An egg on a conveyor rail is not counted by any critter sensor.
- A rail marks the item it carries as stored without giving it a storage (it fires the store event with a plain true). Nothing else does: an egg in an incubator or in a duplicant's hands has a real storage, and an egg on the floor is not stored. That combination is how the mod recognizes a rail egg.
- Eggs on the floor, in incubators, in storage or carried by duplicants count exactly as before.
- When an egg leaves the rail the game's own update lists it again within a second; the mod keeps no state.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-ee826a4ccee7

- **Unlisting a rail egg**: `Prefix` then `OnRail` — see `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs`
- **Tests**: `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails.Tests/Eggs.cs` covers a floor egg (counted), a rail egg (not counted, whether counted before or never, counted again off the rail) and an incubator egg (counted)

## Related
**Id:** blk-e8208f2a5ef0

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Domain Glossary

Terms used in the Don't Count Eggs on Rails mod (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`). For the classes and patches behind them, see the entities document.

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-77b4fbda4643

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod is for |
| DCEOR | Don't Count Eggs on Rails | Prefix of the in-game test names in `Eggs.cs` |
| SMI | State machine instance | `OvercrowdingMonitor.Instance smi`, the patch's argument |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-fa9a4522cadc

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Stored egg | Egg on a rail | A rail marks its item stored with no storage; an egg in an incubator is also stored but has a real storage and is still counted |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-661bdc636455

### Critter sensor
**Id:** blk-4a5e82831748  
**Definition**: Automation sensor that counts the critters and eggs the game lists for its room and switches on a threshold.  
**Used in**: the problem the mod fixes

### Room and cavity
**Id:** blk-37f904dc661d  
**Definition**: A room is a prober-detected enclosed area; the egg's `cavity` is the room list it is currently in. `RemoveFromCavity` takes it out.  
**Used in**: `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch`

### Room prober
**Id:** blk-f818fb057849  
**Definition**: `Game.Instance.roomProber`, the game system that tracks rooms and their contents.  
**Used in**: `UpdateRoom(cavity)` call in the prefix

### Overcrowding monitor
**Id:** blk-bd3bc3efff75  
**Definition**: `OvercrowdingMonitor`, the state machine on critters and eggs that lists them in their room once a second (`UpdateRegion`).  
**Used in**: the patch target

### Conveyor rail
**Id:** blk-1f8734576039  
**Definition**: The solid conduit network (shipping rail) that moves packets of items through the world and so through rooms.  
**Used in**: the rail egg condition

### Stored tag
**Id:** blk-85612028f708  
**Definition**: `GameTags.Stored`, set on an item inside a storage, and set by a rail on its packet's item without any storage behind it.  
**Used in**: `OnRail`

## Related
**Id:** blk-a89b35e148f6

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# dont-count-eggs-on-rails

## What this is
**Id:** blk-edbb0dfde74e

Don't Count Eggs on Rails is an Oxygen Not Included mod: critter sensors no longer count eggs that are riding a conveyor rail through the room. Eggs on the floor, in incubators or carried by duplicants count as before. It patches `OvercrowdingMonitor.UpdateRegion`. Version 0.1.0 in `mod_info.yaml` (released 2026-10-09), minimum supported build 744825, published on the Steam Workshop.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-d02ae3ef8404

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/DontCountEggsOnRails/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` holds the entry point and the `OvercrowdingMonitor.UpdateRegion` patch; `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/DontCountEggsOnRails.Tests/`: in-game tests (`Eggs.cs`).
- `preview/`: before and after screenshots and the preview image with its source.
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and the packaged mod.

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

---
doc_id: doc-e0ba6af997a6
description: "C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions for Don't Count Eggs on Rails (keeps eggs on conveyor rails out of critter sensor counts), with this mod's own layout."

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-f61f2288e82e

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-a3e384879caa

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-527ddcf84ecb

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-8bb005c4e96e

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-ad40ad142018

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-bac1fa61cd8a

### Organization
**Id:** blk-527b18e7c558

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-b243414742bb

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-922fd4a4d120

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-9dbadebf4997

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-838f08430525

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-e528b6f5c462

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-42d32a037e13

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-e4043aca66fc

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-8f46b5b1e7a3

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-a2e97c0e50fa

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-d536a96e7ec3

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-6da88cee9129

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-ed4d88eb38f6

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Don't Count Eggs on Rails specifics
**Id:** blk-d3ccac80ebf9

- The whole mod is one file, `src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs`: the `UserMod2` class and one public static patch class, `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch`, with a public `Prefix`.
- No PLib, no translations, no options.
- The patch's XML summary carries the explanation of the game mechanics; keep it in step with any change.

## Related
**Id:** blk-db2f21bdfcaf

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-8a10d48f5a47
description: "How Don't Count Eggs on Rails guards its Harmony patches, reflection lookups and file reads, and what it logs when something is missing."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Error Handling Conventions

## Principles
**Id:** blk-35aca7b20886

1. **Never break the game for a mod's sake.** A patch that cannot do its job leaves the vanilla behaviour in place and says so in the log. It does not throw into the game's update loop.
2. **Check what you patch.** Game updates rename fields and move code. Every reflection lookup, transpiler match and prefab or tech lookup is checked for a miss.
3. **Say what degraded.** A warning names the thing that was not found and the consequence, so a bug report with `Player.log` is enough to diagnose.
4. **Don't swallow.** A `catch` logs and either returns a safe default or continues; it is never empty.
5. **Log at the right level.** `Debug.Log` for start-up and summaries, `Debug.LogWarning` for degraded behaviour, `Debug.LogError` for a failed player action.

There is no custom exception hierarchy. Mods are small patches over game code, so errors are handled where they occur.

## Guarding Patches
**Id:** blk-c77f84fd876e

### Missing member: warn, leave vanilla
**Id:** blk-d4e18f40f032

A reflection lookup that returns null is checked before use. The patch then does nothing, or returns `true` from a prefix so the game's method runs.

```csharp
if (ActiveField == null || StorageField == null)
	return true; // the game renamed its fields: leave vanilla alone rather than throw
```
(`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/Patches.cs`; the warning is logged once at load by `SimTransferMethod` in `FridgeThermostat.cs`.)

### Transpiler: count the match
**Id:** blk-0b1f765c56ad

A transpiler counts the instructions it replaced. Zero (or more than expected) logs a warning and returns the original code, so a game update disables the change instead of breaking the method.

```csharp
if (swapped == 0)
	Debug.LogWarning("[CornerBuildAnything] " + where + " does not load OffsetGroups.InvertedStandardTable; corner reach not applied there");
```
(`mods/corner-build-anything/src/CornerBuildAnything/ReachTablePatches.cs`; same pattern in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs` and `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`.)

### Missing data: warn, continue
**Id:** blk-c818cc08ccb1

A build-menu, tech or asset lookup that finds nothing warns and keeps the mod working:

```csharp
Tech tech = Db.Get().Techs.TryGet(TechId);
if (tech == null)
{
	Debug.LogWarning("[SmartWeightPlate] Tech '" + TechId + "' not found; building will be unlocked from the start");
	return;
}
```
(`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Patches.cs`; also `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor`, `mods/storage-pod-redux`.) Missing art or a missing vanilla prefab degrades the same way (`Display.UseAnim` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`, `mods/multichannel-critter-sensor/src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`).

### Null checks on game objects
**Id:** blk-5b2181c3b848

Components and arguments that can be absent are tested before use: `if (stt == null || !Sim.IsValidHandle(stt.SimHandle)) return true;`, `if (sensor == null || GameScenePartitioner.Instance == null) return;` (`mods/motion-sensor-range/src/MotionSensorRange/RangeSlider.cs`).

### Warn once
**Id:** blk-21f0f05cd45d

Work that repeats every frame or tick warns once behind a flag (`warnedMissingInternals` in `RangeSlider.cs`).

## try/catch
**Id:** blk-dc492987de9b

`try`/`catch (Exception e)` is used in four situations and nowhere else:

1. **Optional integration with another mod.** Patching or reading another mod's types may fail for any reason. Log the message and skip the integration (`BetterAutomationOverlayCompat.Apply` in `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`; `mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Compat/BlueprintsCompat.cs`).
2. **File and JSON reads and writes.** Return an empty or null result (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan/Presets.cs`, `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/ModDetection.cs`, `mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ToolIcon.cs`).
3. **Patches that run inside worldgen or per-cell work**, where an escaping exception kills a thread or a whole pass (`mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/FeaturePatch.cs`, `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `Patches.cs`, `Census.cs`).
4. **Per-job work in a queue**, so one failure does not stop the rest (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Tool/PlacementQueue.cs`, logged with `Debug.LogError`).

The message form is `"[<Name>] <what was skipped>: " + e.Message`. Use `e.GetBaseException().Message` when the exception may be a reflection wrapper, and the full `e` when the stack trace is needed.

### Finalizer for a thread with no handler
**Id:** blk-ae488fe9cdb7

`Cluster.BeginGeneration` is the worldgen thread body and has none; an exception ends the thread and the loading screen waits forever. A finalizer reports the failure through the game's own error path and logs the exception (`Cluster_BeginGeneration_Patch` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/WorldgenThreadPatch.cs`).

## Yielding to Other Mods
**Id:** blk-72eeec90c0da

When another mod already does the job or shares an id, the mod steps aside and logs why:
- Bitshifter disables itself when Digital CPU is enabled or the contested methods already have Harmony owners (`WhyYield` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Storage Pod Redux does not register its buildings while the original Storage Pod is enabled, and logs a warning telling the player to disable one (`mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Mod.cs`).

## Logging
**Id:** blk-c82780677c34

### Log Levels
**Id:** blk-758f372b8ceb

| Level | Use For | Example |
|-------|---------|---------|
| `Debug.LogError` | A player action failed and was abandoned | `PlacementQueue` in `mods/upgrade-planner` |
| `Debug.LogWarning` | Degraded or skipped behaviour | the examples above |
| `Debug.Log` | Load line, a one-line summary of what a pass changed | `Tagged N refined metal(s)` in `mods/refined-building` |

### What to Include
**Id:** blk-1b8845b3ed69

- The `[<ModName>] ` prefix on every line; `JumperBridgesMod.LogPrefix` holds it for that mod.
- What was expected, what was found, and what the mod does instead.
- Cell numbers, building names and element ids when they identify the case (`mods/vent-freeze-fix`).
- Per-tick or per-frame telemetry only behind a debug option (`VentFreezeWatcher.Verbose`, `DebugSave.Enabled`) or capped (`DetailLines` in `SettleSimPatch.cs`).

PLib's `PUtil.Log*` helpers are not used; all mods log through `Debug`.

## Anti-Patterns to Avoid
**Id:** blk-a00fdf9419dc

### Swallowing exceptions
**Id:** blk-b05aa6148414

An empty `catch` hides a broken patch. The one `catch` that returns a fallback without a log is `GuessLanguageCode` in `common/src/Translations.cs`, because a missing language preference is the normal case before the game has started.

### Throwing from a patch
**Id:** blk-c78d3dac0ff4

An exception in a prefix or postfix on a per-frame or sim method repeats every frame. Guard, log once, return.

### Assuming the game's internals
**Id:** blk-0bb8b9b635ac

Reading a private field by name without a null check on the `FieldInfo`, or replacing an instruction without confirming it was found, breaks on the next game update.

### Silent degradation
**Id:** blk-0862a72ac620

Doing nothing without a log line leaves a player and the author guessing. Every skipped path logs.

### Spamming the log
**Id:** blk-681fccb8166b

A warning inside an update method fires thousands of times. Use a once-flag.

## Project-Specific Patterns
**Id:** blk-49b5b5ef421e

### Don't Count Eggs on Rails specifics
**Id:** blk-eb96ea719f12

- The prefix returns `true` (vanilla runs) for anything that is not an egg on a rail: `!smi.IsEgg || !OnRail(smi)`.
- `OnRail` null-checks the `Pickupable` before reading `storage`.
- On a rail the prefix removes the egg from its cavity, refreshes the room, clears `smi.cavity` and returns `false`. No logging beyond the load line.

## Related
**Id:** blk-657a71205dbb

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-4e7e5a23b6de
description: "File, namespace, patch class, string key and id naming for Don't Count Eggs on Rails (project DontCountEggsOnRails)."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Naming Conventions

## Files and Directories
**Id:** blk-bda13771ab1c

### General Rules
**Id:** blk-60cba07bd52f

- A mod lives in `mods/<kebab-case-name>/` (`natural-backwalls-everywhere`, `just-fall-already`).
- Its code is under `mods/<name>/src/<PascalName>/` with a matching `src/<PascalName>.Tests/` project. `AssemblyName`, `RootNamespace` and the project folder share one PascalCase name (`DontCountEggsOnRails`).
- C# files are PascalCase and named for the main type they hold. One concept per file; small related types may share a file (`Display` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Release tags are `<mod-folder>-v<version>` (repository README).

### Examples by Type
**Id:** blk-00fe6a155298

| Type | Convention | Example |
|------|------------|---------|
| Mod entry class | `Mod.cs`, class `<Name>Mod : UserMod2` | `BitshifterMod` in `Mod.cs` |
| Harmony patches | `Patches.cs`, or a file named for what is patched | `PlanetoidPatch.cs`, `SettleSimPatch.cs` |
| Building config | `<Building>Config.cs`, class `<Building>Config : IBuildingConfig` with `public const string ID` | `SmartWeightPlateConfig.cs` |
| Side screen | `<Building>SideScreen.cs` | `SmartWeightPlateSideScreen.cs` |
| Components | `<Thing>.cs` named for the component | `FridgeThermostat.cs`, `ZoneStore.cs` |
| Strings | `ModStrings.cs` | `mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/ModStrings.cs` |
| Options | `Options.cs`, class `Options` | `mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs` |
| Tests | `<Topic>.cs` in `<Name>.Tests`, one static class per topic | `Reach.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `Persistence.cs`; `Kit.cs` for shared helpers |
| Mod metadata | `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml` in the project folder | `staticID: "Isochronous.<PascalName>"` |
| Translations | `translations/<locale>.po`, template `<Name>.pot` | `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/translations` |
| Art | `anim/` (kanim files), `assets/` | `bitshifter_ribbon_reader_kanim` |
| Release material | `mods/<name>/publish/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` | |

## Code Naming
**Id:** blk-963f8b5d8cc5

### Variables
**Id:** blk-96641cb455da

- camelCase for locals, parameters and private instance fields; no underscore prefix.
- PascalCase for constants (`ArmSeconds`, `Bits`, `TechId`) and for `static readonly` values that act as constants or lookups (`Standard`, `YieldToWorkshopIds`, `Contested`).
- camelCase for private static mutable state and caches (`armed`, `scratch`, `lastGrid`, `symbols`, `anyRows`).
- Descriptive names; single letters only for loop indexes and the `e` of a catch.

```csharp
private const float ArmSeconds = 2f;
private static readonly Dictionary<int, float> armed = new Dictionary<int, float>();
```
(`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`)

### Functions/Methods
**Id:** blk-87c87a477bad

- PascalCase, starting with a verb: `Apply`, `Decide`, `SwapTable`, `CopyRangeFrom`, `ApplyRange`.
- Game callbacks keep the game's names (`OnSpawn`, `OnPrefabInit`, `OnCleanUp`, `Sim1000ms`).
- Harmony methods are named for their kind: `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler`, `Finalizer`, plus `Prepare`, `TargetMethod`, `TargetMethods`.

### Classes/Types/Interfaces
**Id:** blk-76d94e5bfa3d

- PascalCase nouns. Interfaces take an `I` prefix (`IPlanTab` and `ITabView` in `mods/upgrade-planner`, and the game's own).
- Harmony patch classes: `<PatchedType>_<PatchedMethod>_Patch` (`LogicRibbonReader_GetBitDepth_Patch`, `Db_Initialize_Patch`, `GeneratedBuildings_LoadGeneratedBuildings_Patch`). A patch for a type with one concern may use `<Type>_Patch` (`LiquidVentConfig_Patch`). Patches nested in a holder class may drop the suffix (`Constructable_OnSpawn` in `ReachTablePatches`).
- Classes are `sealed` unless built for inheritance. The mod class is `public sealed`. Types the game does not reach are `internal`.
- Option enums and nested helper types are PascalCase (`CoolPodMode`, `BridgeKind`).

### Booleans
**Id:** blk-0bce9f156a11

- Prefix with `Is`, `Has`, `Can`, `Should` or name the state: `IsEnabled`, `OriginalActive`, `isSpawned`, `warnedMissingInternals`.

### Strings (`ModStrings`)
**Id:** blk-3b01141de9e6

- `ModStrings` mirrors the game's `STRINGS` tree: nested static classes and `LocString` fields in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. `ModStrings.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME` is registered as `STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.<BUILDINGID>.NAME`, the key the game looks a building name up by (`mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/ModStrings.cs`).
- Mod-private text goes under a branch named for the mod in capitals (`ModStrings.SALTYSURF.ELEMENT_LIST`, `ModStrings.JUMPERBRIDGES.OPTIONS`).
- Option keys are written out as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.<OPTION>.NAME` and `.TOOLTIP`; categories as `STRINGS.<MOD>.OPTIONS.CATEGORY.<NAME>`.
- Long branches are shortened with an alias at the top of the file (`using OPTIONS = NaturalBackwalls.ModStrings.NATURALBACKWALLS.OPTIONS;`).

### Ids and Tags
**Id:** blk-e26da3e96b16

- Building ids are PascalCase and match the config class (`SmartWeightPlate`); a mod that replaces another mod's buildings reuses that mod's ids (`StoragePodConfig`, `CoolPodConfig` in `mods/storage-pod-redux`).
- Tags and PAction ids carry a mod prefix: `DetectAnyElement_Any`, `Isochronous.SweepZones.Tool`.
- The `staticID` in `mod.yaml` is `Isochronous.<PascalName>`.
- Test names start with the mod's name or an abbreviation of it: `[OniTest("Bitshifter: a NOT gate on a ribbon inverts every bit")]`, `VFF:` for Vent Freeze Fix.

## Project-Specific Conventions
**Id:** blk-d13b62f0ae51

### Don't Count Eggs on Rails specifics
**Id:** blk-f396cf5b26c8

- One patch, named `<Type>_<Method>_Patch`; helper `OnRail` is private static.
- Test class `Eggs` in `src/DontCountEggsOnRails.Tests/Eggs.cs`.
- Log prefix `[DontCountEggsOnRails]`; `staticID` `Isochronous.DontCountEggsOnRails`.

## Related
**Id:** blk-d7754c53f7b5

- See also: [code style](code-style.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

---
witness_digest: "sha256:ef46729018139a2309bdcd5cdc1cb45c601d5d52cc19e58efd8b43fca4df915d"
witness: loose
applies_to:
  - "src/JumperBridges/**"
doc_id: doc-dfca545db3a4
description: "Entities, business rules and key code paths of jumper-bridges: bridge ends on ports, end nodes and link rings"
---

# Jumper Bridges domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-934528d428c9

Jumper Bridges lets an Automation Wire Bridge or Automation Ribbon Bridge, and a Wire Bridge, Conductive Wire Bridge or Insulated Wire Bridge, be placed with either end directly on a port cell, with that port counting as connected. It adds no buildings. A bridge end with no wire under it gets a stand-in node that makes the game's own network rules carry the signal or current into the port. Source is in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-dbb08ca2d7f3

### JumperBridgesMod
**Id:** blk-45611b9a4ffc  
**Description**: The `UserMod2` entry point. Loads `Options` before `base.OnLoad` (which applies the patches) and sets each `BridgeKind.Enabled`, so a kind that is off has its patches skipped through `Prepare()`. Then initializes PLib, registers `ModStrings` with `Isochronous.Translations` and registers the options screen.  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs`

### Options
**Id:** blk-f92ca7ddeb23  
**Description**: PLib options saved in the shared config location, both restart-required.  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Options.cs`

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| AutomationBridges | bool (default true) | Direct automation bridges; off leaves automation bridges to the base game |
| PowerBridges | bool (default true) | Direct power bridges; off leaves power bridges to the base game |

**Relationships**: option names and tooltips are string keys under `STRINGS.JUMPERBRIDGES.OPTIONS` defined in `ModStrings.cs`; translations load from `translations/<locale>.po`.

### BridgeKind
**Id:** blk-e978d080073f  
**Description**: What differs between automation and power: the network manager, layers and wire art. Two instances, `Logic` and `Power`, in `BridgeKind.All`. Each keeps its own live node table, so an automation and a power bridge end on one cell are on two separate networks. `Of(BuildingDef)` maps `BuildLocationRule.LogicBridge` to Logic and `BuildLocationRule.WireBridge` to Power; the heavy-watt joint plates have their own rule and are left alone.  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/BridgeKind.cs`

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| Source | ConnectionSource | `Logic` or `Electrical` |
| TileLayer / WireLayer / ReplacementLayer / EndLayer | ObjectLayer | Logic: LogicWireTile, LogicWire, ReplacementLogicWire, LogicGate. Power: WireTile, Wire, ReplacementWire, WireConnectors |
| SceneLayer | Grid.SceneLayer | LogicWires or Wires |
| Enabled | bool | Set from the options at load |
| Nodes | Dictionary<int, BridgeEndNode> | Live nodes by cell, one per cell |
| Manager, Items, Links | game network manager and its private `items` and `links` tables | Read by reflection on cold paths |

**Relationships**: `NodeAnim` picks the wire kanim a node plays: `logic_wires_kanim` or `logic_ribbon_kanim` (by the link's bit depth), and for power `utilities_electric_kanim`, `utilities_electric_conduct_kanim` or `utilities_electric_rubber_kanim`.

### JumperBridge
**Id:** blk-c5d470758241  
**Description**: `KMonoBehaviour` on every complete bridge of an enabled kind. Gives each end that has no wire under it a `BridgeEndNode` (creation deferred a frame so a loaded save's wires have marked their cells first), removes the nodes when the bridge is deconstructed or broken (`BuildingBroken`) and recreates them on repair (`BuildingFullyRepaired`).  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/JumperBridge.cs`

**Relationships**: requires `UtilityNetworkLink`; owns up to two `BridgeEndNode`s; `Inherit` passes a leaving wire's connections to the node that replaces it.

### BridgeEndNode
**Id:** blk-a0f2a41a1467  
**Description**: A `KAnimGraphTileVisualizer` on a standalone GameObject (no building) that stands in for a wire under a bridge end. It makes the three registrations a wire makes: the wire tile layer, a physical network node with connection bits and a network item at the cell, so the port there is told it is connected. It plays the wire kanim and mirrors the connection bits its neighbours point at it. Several bridge ends on one cell share one node, which goes with its last owner. It costs nothing, yields nothing, has no deconstruct order and is not saved. On a power network it is not a `Wire`, so the circuit's wattage limit is the bridge's own.  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/BridgeEndNode.cs`

**Relationships**: owned by one or more `JumperBridge`s; registered in `BridgeKind.Nodes`.

### BridgeFootprint
**Id:** blk-f00f2e956606  
**Description**: Registry of where every bridge is, by cell, on the complete and the under-construction prefab. The game puts a bridge on its end layer only at its two end cells and this mod stops a bridge taking that slot from a port or earlier bridge, so a bridge with both ends taken is on no layer. The deconstruct, cancel and prioritize tools find it here by its end cells.  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/BridgeFootprint.cs`

### BridgeLinks
**Id:** blk-67d61b61d321  
**Description**: Owns the network manager's link table for groups of bridges that share end cells. The manager keeps one link partner per cell, so after any bridge connects or disconnects, the distinct cells of its group are rewritten as a directed ring (c0 to c1 to ... to c0), sorted so the write is idempotent, then the networks are rebuilt.  
**Location**: `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/BridgeLinks.cs`

### Harmony patches
**Id:** blk-a88b0d39bc11  
**Description**: The game classes and methods patched, grouped by purpose, all in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`. A group is skipped when its kind is off.
- Bridge setup (automation): `LogicWireBridgeConfig` and `LogicRibbonBridgeConfig` `DoPostConfigureComplete` and `DoPostConfigureUnderConstruction` add `JumperBridge` and `BridgeFootprint`.
- Bridge setup (power): `WireBridgeConfig` `DoPostConfigureComplete` and `DoPostConfigureUnderConstruction`.
- Placement: `BuildingDef.MarkArea`, `AreLogicPortsInValidPositions`, `IsValidWireBridgeLocation`, `IsValidHighWattBridgeLocation`, `ArePowerPortsInValidPositions`, `MarkOverlappingPorts`.
- Ports: `LogicPorts.CreatePhysicalPorts`, `DestroyPhysicalPorts`, `CreateVisualizers` (skipped for bridges).
- Links: `LogicUtilityNetworkLink` and `WireUtilityNetworkLink` `OnConnect` and `OnDisconnect` call `BridgeLinks`.
- Wire art and drags: `KAnimGraphTileVisualizer.OnSpawn`, `UpdateConnections`, `OnCleanUp`; `BaseUtilityBuildTool.BuildPath`.
- Tools: `DisconnectTool.OnDragComplete` and `OnMouseMove`; `DeconstructTool.DeconstructCell`; `CancelTool.OnDragTool`; `PrioritizeTool.OnDragTool`.
- Overlays: `OverlayModes.Logic` and `OverlayModes.Power` `Update` and `Disable`.

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-4bb5a42c53b7

- A bridge end may sit on any port cell (a machine's input or output, a gate's port, another bridge's end) and the port is on the bridge's network with no wire laid first. Chains work, and several bridges may meet at one cell.
- A bridge end behaves like a wire cell: it connects only to cells a wire drag explicitly joined it to, never because a wire sits next to it.
- A bridge end on a real wire works as in the base game and gets no node.
- A bridge end on a gate does not put the gate out of order.
- Deconstructing the bridge removes the node; wires that led into the end redraw as dead ends at once.
- Overload is unchanged: a wire bridge carrying a ribbon signal is damaged as in the base game, and a broken bridge's ends stop conducting until repaired.
- A power bridge end may not sit on a heavy-watt joint plate's end, and joint plates are unchanged. A building may be placed with its power port on an existing bridge end.
- Each kind can be turned off in the options (restart required); a kind that is off is left to the base game.
- The bridges' own two end ports are kept as geometry but never register as ports, which also removes the base game's silent port displacement when two ports share a cell. They no longer show in the automation overlay.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-852815eed994

- **Startup**: options read, kinds enabled, patches applied (with `Prepare` skipping disabled kinds) — see `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs`
- **Bridge spawns**: `JumperBridge.OnSpawn` schedules node creation, `BridgeEndNode.Create` builds the node, `BridgeLinks.OnConnect` rewrites the ring — see `JumperBridge.cs`, `BridgeEndNode.cs`, `BridgeLinks.cs`
- **Wire drag onto a bridge end**: `BaseUtilityBuildTool.BuildPath` patch reads the drag's bits into the node — see `Patches.cs`
- **Deconstruct by ends**: `DeconstructTool.DeconstructCell` and `BridgeFootprint.EndsAt` — see `Patches.cs`, `BridgeFootprint.cs`
- **Design record**: the investigation notes (section 6 covers the design) are kept outside this repository
- **Tests**: in-game tests in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges.Tests/` (`Signals.cs`, `Gates.cs`, `WireDrags.cs`, `WireUnderEnd.cs`, `Deconstruct.cs`, `Power.cs`, plus explicit `Preview.cs`); `README.md` carries the manual in-game checklist for what is not yet automated

## Related
**Id:** blk-02f47981e0e0

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Domain Glossary

Terms used in the Jumper Bridges mod (`mods/jumper-bridges`). For the classes and patches behind them, see the entities document.

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-331987027e34

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod is for |
| kanim | Klei animation | The wire art a node plays, for example `logic_wires_kanim` |
| PLib | Peter Han's Library | Options screen and library init in `Mod.cs` and `Options.cs` |
| Logic | Automation (code name) | `BridgeKind.Logic`, `LogicPorts`, `LogicWire`: the game's code says "logic" for automation |
| Power / Electrical | Power network | `BridgeKind.Power`; `ConnectionSource.Electrical` |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-b1e1a23dc016

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Invisible wire, hidden wire | Bridge end node | The node is not a wire building; it has no cost, yield or deconstruct order |
| Logic bridge (in player text) | Automation bridge | The game and the README call the buildings Automation Wire Bridge and Automation Ribbon Bridge |
| Wire under the end (for the node) | Bridge end node | A real wire under an end means no node is made |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-48cc95762b31

### Bridge end
**Id:** blk-fa52bd2fd391  
**Definition**: One of a bridge's two end cells, which the game finds through the bridge's input ports.  
**Used in**: all files

### Bridge end node
**Id:** blk-2b5366f53fe2  
**Definition**: The stand-in for a wire under a bridge end: a building-less GameObject that registers the wire tile layer, a physical node and a network item so the port at that cell is connected.  
**Used in**: `BridgeEndNode`, `JumperBridge`

### Port
**Id:** blk-a6f1b2b01703  
**Definition**: A building's automation input or output, or a power input or output, at a cell. A port counts as connected when its cell is on a network.  
**Used in**: placement patches, `LogicPorts` patches

### Automation, ribbon, bit depth
**Id:** blk-a466b94b963a  
**Definition**: Automation is the game's logic wiring. A ribbon carries four signals on one wire (`LogicWire.BitDepth.FourBit`); the ribbon bridge's node plays `logic_ribbon_kanim`.  
**Used in**: `BridgeKind.NodeAnim`

### Utility network
**Id:** blk-8f0976689c96  
**Definition**: The game's generic flood-filled network over cells that hold a conductor (`UtilityNetworkManager`); both automation and power networks are one. Bridges join two cells through the manager's link table.  
**Used in**: `BridgeKind`, `BridgeLinks`

### Link and link ring
**Id:** blk-b6960c2ccb0d  
**Definition**: The manager keeps one link partner per cell. For bridges that share cells, the mod writes a directed ring over the group's cells so the fill reaches all of them.  
**Used in**: `BridgeLinks`

### Object layer
**Id:** blk-251bdb713081  
**Definition**: `ObjectLayer`, the game's per-cell slot lists. A wire tile layer cell is what a network flood fill requires; an end layer (LogicGate, WireConnectors) is where the game marks a bridge's end cells.  
**Used in**: `BridgeKind`, `BridgeFootprint`

### Joint plate (heavy-watt)
**Id:** blk-279f9dc39e51  
**Definition**: The heavy-watt joint plate, a power connector with its own placement rule. The mod leaves it alone and refuses a power bridge end on its end.  
**Used in**: `IsValidHighWattBridgeLocation` patch

### Wire drag
**Id:** blk-d0010eca3d9e  
**Definition**: Dragging the wire tool across cells; it joins consecutive cells by connection bits. A bridge end connects to a neighbour only through a drag.  
**Used in**: `BaseUtilityBuildTool.BuildPath` patch, `WireDrags.cs` tests

### Disconnect tool
**Id:** blk-8e5c50d5554a  
**Definition**: The tool that cuts connections between adjacent wire cells; the mod makes it cut at bridge ends too.  
**Used in**: `DisconnectTool` patches

### Overload
**Id:** blk-6b907dab8e6f  
**Definition**: A wire bridge carrying a ribbon signal is damaged as in the base game and breaks, which disconnects its link until repaired.  
**Used in**: `JumperBridge.OnBroken`, `OnRepaired`

### Overlay
**Id:** blk-3955244df226  
**Definition**: The automation or power view that colours wires by network; the mod colours node pieces the same way.  
**Used in**: `OverlayModes` patches

## Related
**Id:** blk-3f15e924a8f5

- See also: [entities](entities.md)

# jumper-bridges

## What this is
**Id:** blk-2d2edc3c3db1

Jumper Bridges is an Oxygen Not Included mod: an Automation Wire Bridge, Automation Ribbon Bridge, Wire Bridge, Conductive Wire Bridge or Insulated Wire Bridge can be placed with either end directly on any automation or power port cell, and that port counts as connected. Each end acts as its own piece of wire, drawn like one, with nothing to build, deconstruct or pay for. Bridges chain end on end, and a wire dragged up to a bridge end joins it. The automation and power halves can each be turned off in the mod options. Version 0.2.0 in `mod_info.yaml` (released 2026-10-17), minimum supported build 744825, published on the Steam Workshop with Korean, Russian and Chinese translations.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-7a7996b980da

Top-level folders and key files:

- `src/JumperBridges/`: the mod. `JumperBridge.cs` (per-bridge component that owns the end nodes), `BridgeEndNode.cs` (the end node, a graph tile visualizer), `BridgeKind.cs` (layers and managers per automation or power kind), `BridgeLinks.cs` (link rings between nodes), `BridgeFootprint.cs` (finds a bridge by its end cells), `Patches.cs` (Harmony patches), `Options.cs` and `ModStrings.cs` (options and translatable strings), `Mod.cs`, `translations/`, `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/JumperBridges.Tests/`: in-game tests for deconstruction, gates, power, preview, signals and wire drags.
- `tools/make_preview.py`: builds the preview image.
- `README.md`: what the mod does, compatibility, installing and how it works.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: release notes per version.
- `publish/`: Workshop description, tags, preview image and the packaged mod (`JumperBridges.zip`, plus `DirectAutomationBridges.zip`, the mod's earlier name).

The `.context/` documents of this node: [domains](domains/README.md) (entities, glossary), [standards](standards/README.md) (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/` and `retrospectives/`.

documents.text:
---
doc_id: doc-8674b988870a
description: "C# formatting, imports, comments, Harmony patch and component conventions for Jumper Bridges (adds automation and power bridges), with this mod's own layout."
applies_to:
  - "src/**"
---
# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-098c307a67e7

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-62b9e07bc5d7

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-7cc833c742eb

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-87d51c25ed66

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-63da0040add9

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-9fc50e5b585e

### Organization
**Id:** blk-584f098bdff5

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-f3f1f9eab24b

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-daffabe9affb

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-f3272b570c51

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-50b0fdfd8b98

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-32d8939ee261

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-c25d3881b7d6

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-6b2f8832d039

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-d5ef39d406e3

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-e4168dc216f0

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-27d655025249

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-86e1c7e9ad24

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-966ebe0cbf67

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Jumper Bridges specifics
**Id:** blk-d5fba21e032c

- `UsePLib`, `UseTranslations` and `ReferenceUnityUI`. `JumperBridgesMod.LogPrefix` (`"[JumperBridges] "`) is the one log-prefix constant in the repository and every log call uses it.
- `OnLoad` order matters: `Options.Load()` and the `BridgeKind.Logic.Enabled` and `BridgeKind.Power.Enabled` flags come before `base.OnLoad`, because patch classes read those flags in `Prepare()` to decide whether to apply (`src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs`, `Patches.cs`).
- `BridgeKind` holds everything that differs between the automation and power kinds (layers, manager, art); the rest of the mod reads from it.
- `JumperBridge`, `BridgeEndNode` and `BridgeFootprint` are the components; `tools/make_preview.py` builds the Workshop preview from the preview tests.

## Related
**Id:** blk-70baa20e27d1

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)
